normalizedText: Assistant Vice President Markets Crisil Mumbai Experience: 5-8 Yrs Salary: Not disclosed Skills: Analytical, Business Management, Investment Banking, Global, Business Development, Financial Research, Capital Market, Banking Products, Secondary Market, Analytics, Derivatives, Transaction Banking, MS Office Tools, Advanced Excel, Quantitative, PowerPoint, MS Office OPPORTUNITY This opportunity is based in Powai, Mumbai. The successful individual in this position will be able to make an immediate effective contribution by drawing upon their previous experience and developing it further by utilizing expertise within Coalition globally. JOB PROFILE The job involves conducting Investment banking financial research to support clients and contribute to the internal knowledge building efforts. Typical projects will involve gathering, analyzing, synthesizing and presenting data using structured methodologies, assumptions, and frameworks. Projects may take couple of days to several weeks for completion. Key responsibilities involve: Build or assist in building and maintaining Investment Banks benchmarking models to estimate granular, product level key performance metrics (e.g., Revenue and Headcount) and create market size estimates for Investment and transaction banking products Model relationships between macroeconomic indicators and IB performance metrics to arrive at forecasts/ estimates for the above KPIs Update and restructure benchmarking models based on qualitative and quantitative information from Coalition contacts in the IB industry Independent decision making to derive product revenues / HC estimates based on deep dive product research and extrinsic indicators baked into the quantitative model. Build and update sector databases in Excel and/or customized applications Explain, defend and customize Coalition analysis to support key client initiatives in IB strategy, sales franchise decision, investor communication and for senior management consumption Craft effective search strategies and gather relevant information leveraging a broad set of resources (e.g. on-line databases, internet articles, external researchers etc.). Utilize both secondary and primary research sources and techniques Assist clients and/or other research delivery team members in articulating and refining research requests and projects, while working on multiple projects Communicate research results through the creation of structured end-products (spreadsheets, reports, presentations etc.) Mentor and train new research analysts Complete ad hoc research requests, knowledge building and business development projects as necessary Manage and/ or work with an expanded team of analysts while working on multiple projects Conduct regular workflow meetings with the in – house and onsite Account managers in London, New York and Singapore Foster a cohesive, creative and comfortable working environment, mediating any personal issue within the team Delegate responsibilities and supervise the work of team members providing guidance and motivation to drive maximum performance. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS The successful candidate will have to demonstrate the following skills, experience and attributes likely to have been gained over two to six years’ relevant experience: MBA or post graduate degree in finance, business management, statistics, economics or similar analytical fields. Professional certifications like CFA, FRM, CAIA etc. would be an added advantage Must have at least 2 years of experience in managing a team size of 5 to 6 Strong quantitative skills, an analytical & Logical mindset and an ability to work with significant amounts of data, both numerical and qualitative Ability to take decisions while working with unstructured and limited information Prior experience in financial research / analytics Sound knowledge of global capital markets or secondary markets products preferred A strong degree of independence and self-motivation Responsible attitude and ability to complete tasks proactively and in a timely manner (both for self and the team) Fluency in spoken and written English is essential Excellent working skills with MS office tools, especially good at advanced Excel and PowerPoint Working knowledge of professional information services like Bloomberg, Thomson Reuters etc preferred

Own the paid media engine for a $1Billion+ brand. Decide what to launch and where the budget goes.Total Annual Package: Up to USD $240,000 + comprehensive benefits (Base salary + monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)Location: Remote (Global)Growth path from here is fluid: all paid channels, including the ones you select, moving toward scope at the intersection of capital allocation, creative strategy, and P&L ownership. What takes 4-5 years elsewhere happens in 1-2 here.We've been AI-first since December 2023: Every proposal that reaches the CEO ships with an LLM validation link. Your first spend case gets stress-tested by an advanced model to eliminate blind spots.Role Overview:Puffy, a market-leading, nine-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Senior Director of Performance Marketing to own a multi-million-dollar monthly paid media engine across Google and Meta with full authority over systems, measurement, creative testing, capital allocation, and team, reporting directly to the CEO.This role exists to convert a multi-million-dollar paid budget into maximum contribution margin, building the decision systems, measurement infrastructure, and team that let the revenue engine run and scale without day-to-day executive involvement.The Problems You'll Own:Primary: Decide what to launch and where the budget goes: A multi-million-dollar monthly budget runs across Google and Meta, and every standard campaign type is already live and optimized: brand and non-brand search, PMax, Meta prospecting and retargeting, Shopping and feed. Growth now has to come from what isn't running: new campaign structures, new creative, a different mix of spend.Secondary: Build the system that runs the scaling decisions: Design and document the rules that govern spend, when to pause, when to increase budget, when to pull back, and the measurement each decision depends on. The system should run the scaling without day-to-day executive oversight.The Career Accelerator:This is not a role where you manage dashboards and present decks.The scope is scarce: very few Senior Directors of Performance Marketing get simultaneous authority over multi-million-dollar monthly budgets on both major platforms, full ownership of measurement and creative systems, org design power, and a direct line to the CEO with no layers in between.Your first 12 months: build pause/hold/scale logic, budget guardrails, and escalation protocols from scratch. Deploy incrementality testing and reconcile platform attribution against backend reality. Architect the creative engine as a system: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, and whitelisting. Design capital allocation on marginal return rather than platform-reported averages. Design promo architecture across the retail calendar: pulse strategy, financing offers, funnel alignment. Identify, evaluate, and pilot paid channels beyond Google and Meta. Structure the performance marketing function itself. Shape the future of performance marketing at Puffy, where paid media is the primary growth lever.What Is In It For You:This isn't just another performance marketing role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.1. Own the Paid Engine End to End, With No Layers Above YouYou set the strategy, build the systems, and own the outcomes.You allocate multi-million-dollar monthly budgets across Google and Meta on marginal return rather than platform-reported averages, design the pause/hold/scale logic and budget guardrails that govern all paid spend, and serve as the single source of truth on paid media performance. Creative runs as a system you architect: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, whitelisting.You hold profitability to a contribution-margin standard after returns and financing costs, not ROAS in isolation. You lead, assess, and structure the performance marketing function with org design authority and CEO sign-off, reporting directly to the CEO.2. Join a High-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales🌍 Great Place to Work Certified💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Your vision is the company's vision.Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high-velocity execution that drives a global brand3. Embrace Radical FlexibilityWork from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co-working space, (OR) our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location.4. Become the Operator Other Brands Try to HireIn most companies, performance marketing leaders inherit a system somebody else built and spend the next three years defending its numbers in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides how much capital goes into growth next quarter, your model is the input to that decision, not a report on it afterwards. You'll leave with a paid media system you designed end to end, and the proof that it held contribution margin at scale, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. Puffy has been AI-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI-native toolbox behind you rather than an agency deck in front of you.What You'll Need:7+ years in performance marketing with sustained ownership of $1M+/month on both Google and Meta (concurrently or across roles). "Ownership" means authority over strategy, structure, and budget, not just execution.Google depth at PMax-era: campaign structure, feed management, brand/non-brand economics.High-AOV considered-purchase experience ($1,000+ order values): sparse-conversion, long-decision-cycle categories.Personally built, not inherited, bid, budget, and pause decision systems at scale. You'll be asked to present a playbook you authored.Statistical decision literacy: volume gating, false-kill vs. wasted-spend trade-offs, threshold derivation, incrementality test design.Creative testing systems at scale in a post-ATT environment: concept-vs-variation discipline, creative analytics.Team leadership including senior direct reports. Experience building or restructuring a performance marketing function.Structured approach to new channel evaluation: selection frameworks, pilot design, budget allocation, and kill criteria.Good-to-Have:Scripting against Meta/Google APIs; Google Ads Scripts.Mixed agency + in-house background.Experience with emerging paid channels (e.g., TikTok, Connected TV, affiliate/partnerships, etc.).D2C e-commerce background in home goods, furniture, or comparable high-AOV verticals.The Puffy DNA: We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.Be the Owner: We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.Execute with Urgency: We thrive in high-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.Demand Excellence: We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.Be AI-First: Daily multi-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.Go All-In: When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.✨ Your Total Compensation & Benefits:💰 Compensation: Total Annual Package: Up to USD $240,000 + comprehensive benefits (Base salary + monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)Annual salary review every January🏥 Health & Protection: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance (based on country of hire)🌴 Time Off: Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) + Public holidays💼 Work Environment:AI-First organization with access to AI-native tool stackRemote First: Work from the comfort of your home officeLearning & development opportunitiesInternational team collaboration across 16+ nationalities. Your assumptions get challenged daily.🏆 Rewards & Recognition:Eligibility for selection to the Leaders Club, an elite recognition program featuring premium wellness memberships, exclusive networking with senior leadership, and annual leadership retreatsEligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company-wide celebration for exceptional contributionsReady to Shape Your Story? True Credits - Head - Risk (10-16 yrs) True Credits Gurugram Experience: 10-16 Yrs Salary: Not disclosed Skills: Underwriting, Risk Analytics, Credit Risk, Risk Management Job Summary: We are seeking a visionary and highly analytical leader to head our Credit Risk Management division. In this pivotal role, you will define, evolve, and execute our comprehensive risk strategy, ensuring the stability and resilience of our digital lending operations. Leveraging advanced predictive modeling and machine learning, you will drive product innovation, enhance portfolio quality, and enable deep financial inclusion for underserved markets. The ideal candidate will combine deep academic excellence in analytics with extensive corporate leadership experience developing profitable underwriting models and risk management strategies across domestic and international markets. Key Responsibilities Strategic Leadership: Formulate and execute the overarching credit risk strategy, risk appetite framework, and governance policy aligned with the company's business growth and financial inclusion goals. Credit Underwriting & Analytics: Design, implement, and scale end-to-end credit underwriting methodologies for a fast-growing digital lending portfolio. Oversee new account policies to optimize risk-adjusted returns. Collections & Recovery Strategy: - Define and optimize data-backed collections strategies, utilizing predictive segmentation (e.g., self-cure models) to customize communication channels, timing, and settlement offers for delinquent portfolios. - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Business Development teams to launch innovative, tech-driven lending features and credit line solutions while keeping NPLs (Non-Performing Loans) within targets. Portfolio Management & Monitoring: Establish robust real-time tracking mechanisms, dashboards, and early-warning systems to proactively identify market shifts, credit deterioration, and portfolio stress. Regulatory & Compliance: Ensure that all risk frameworks, lending procedures, and data governance policies strictly comply with central banking regulations (e.g., RBI guidelines) and data privacy standards. Team Building: Mentor, scale, and lead a high-performing team of data scientists, risk analysts, and credit managers, fostering a culture of innovation, data-driven execution, and collaboration. Required Qualifications & Experience: Experience: - 10+ years of robust experience in Risk Management & Advanced Analytics, within leading financial services (Credit Cards/Consumer Lending) or high-growth FinTech ecosystems (Digital Wallets, Buy Now Pay Later, Personal Loans). - Leadership Background: Proven track record in an executive or senior leadership capacity (e.g., CRO, SVP, or Head of Risk) managing large, cross-functional analytics and machine learning teams. Domain Expertise: Expert knowledge of international or domestic consumer lending frameworks, behavioral scorecards, machine learning algorithms, and alternate data modeling. Technical Acumen: Proficient understanding of data architecture, Python/R, SQL, and state-of-the-art ML frameworks (XGBoost, neural networks, etc.) used in building predictive credit models. Communication: Exceptional interpersonal and executive communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex statistical models into actionable strategic recommendations for Board-level and external stakeholders.

normalizedText: About UptimeAIUptimeAI provides AI reasoning agents that help industrial operations teams make goal-oriented, real-time decisions.Industrial facilities are rich in data but constrained by the expertise required to maintain and interpret it. As experienced engineers retire and operational complexity grows, organizations struggle to scale the expert judgment needed to maintain reliability, safety, and performance.UptimeAI addresses this challenge by embedding engineering reasoning directly into AI agents that continuously analyze operational data, diagnose issues, and guide teams toward the best actions. The result is faster decisions, reduced downtime, improved efficiency, and stronger operational performance.Role : Senior Manager, Customer Success Lead – APAC & Middle EastLocation: Bangalore, India (Hybrid)Experience: 8+ yearsReports to: VP Customer SuccessAbout The RoleThe Senior Manager, Customer Success Lead – APAC & Middle East is a player-coach leader responsible for driving customer outcomes, value realization, and scalable Customer Success execution across the region.This role combines strategic account ownership, value consulting, executive customer engagement, and team leadership. The leader will directly own a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers while building, coaching, and scaling a high-performing Customer Success team.The ideal candidate is a trusted customer advisor who can personally lead complex customer engagements, demonstrate measurable business value, and develop CSMs to operate with the same level of strategic ownership and customer focus.Success role: Vice President - Wealth Management - Bank (16-20 yrs)
normalizedText: Vice President - Wealth Management - Bank (16-20 yrs) Pylon Management Consulting Gurugram Experience: 16-20 Yrs Salary: Not disclosed Skills: Wealth Management, Private Banking, Portfolio Management, Investment Banking, Banking, BFSI Sales - This role is responsible for leading the Front Office organization in India (~200 FTEs), delivering high quality front office enablement to Portfolio Managers, Trust Officers, Investment Strategists, and CIO partners globally. - The role requires a senior wealth management leader with experience in large, sophisticated financial institutions capable of operating at a Vice President level with strong people leadership, domain depth, and strategic execution skills. - This leader will act as a strategic extension of the Private Bank front office, combining wealth domain expertise with operational leadership and stakeholder influence. Responsibilities Front Office Partnership & Strategic Execution - Serve as a senior partner to Private Bank, ISG, and CIO stakeholders, supporting delivery priorities and evolving business needs. - Execute and continuously evolve the GWIM Front Office delivery model, aligned to investment strategy, fiduciary obligations, and client experience expectations. - Support complex initiatives spanning Alternatives, structured investments, custom portfolio solutions, and fiduciary modernization. Operational & Delivery Leadership : Own end to end delivery across : - Portfolio administration, analytics, and performance reporting - Client presentations and investment communications - Trust and fiduciary account reviews and administration - Research and investment support activities - Drive process improvement, automation, and efficiency through simplification, data, and technology adoption. - Ensure strong risk, control, and compliance discipline, aligned to global regulatory and fiduciary standards. People Leadership & Talent Development - Lead and develop a large, multi location organization (~200 associates) including managers and future leaders. - Build a high performance and inclusive culture, with strong focus on coaching, engagement, and retention. - Develop succession plans and leadership pipeline for critical roles. Stakeholder Management & Influence - Partner closely with Line of Business leaders, Control Functions, Technology, and GBS leadership. - Effectively collaborate and influence across a matrixed, global organization. - Represent the India Front Office function in global forums as required. Financial & Resource Management - Own budget, expense discipline, capacity planning, and productivity outcomes for the function. - Balance growth, efficiency, and risk objectives. Requirements Education : MBA, CFA, CA, CPA or equivalent professionally qualified background (mandatory) Foundational Skills : - Proven experience leading large front office or near front office teams supporting Portfolio Managers, Advisors, CIO, or Trust/Fiduciary functions. - Demonstrated ability to operate effectively at senior leadership / VP level interfaces. Strong understanding of : - Portfolio construction and performance measurement - Investment products across traditional and alternative asset classes - Trust, estate, and fiduciary services - Client reporting and investment communications - Working knowledge of wealth and market data platforms (e.g., Bloomberg, FactSet, Refinitiv). Leadership Competencies: - Strong executive presence with excellent communication and influencing skills. - Demonstrated people first leadership style with a focus on high engagement and outcomes. - Strong risk and control mindset. - Proven ability to coach, mentor, and build leadership capability at scale.

Associate Director Axtria Noida Experience: 9-14 Yrs Salary: Not disclosed Skills: accounting, taxation, direct and indirect taxation, indirect taxation, finance, indirect, auditing, project management, budgeting, risk management, program management, delivery management, vp, business development, consulting, heading Proven experience in a leadership role with a track record of success. . Strong understanding of industry trends and best practices. Experience working with cross-functional teams to drive business outcomes

GENERAL DESCRIPTION Julius Baer is advancing its digital agenda across Asia, leveraging technology to strengthen client service, operational resilience, and sustainable growth. As part of this ambition, we are seeking a skilled and motivated Head of Digital Transformation India to lead our engineering team in Chennai. This leadership role is central to ensuring high-quality, compliant, and timely delivery of technology initiatives while developing a capable and engaged engineering workforce. Reporting to the Head of Digital Transformation Asia, you will oversee all delivery and people aspects of the India-based engineering unit, acting as a key enabler of regional transformation outcomes. With a strong focus on governance, collaboration, and team development, this position demands a leader who can balance operational rigour with strategic insight—driving delivery excellence within one of the world’s most respected wealth management institutions. KEY FEATURES OF THE POSITION Delivery Leadership · Oversee end-to-end delivery performance of the India engineering team, ensuring alignment with project timelines, business commitments, and quality standards. · Implement and govern structured delivery processes across agile and iterative workstreams to ensure predictability, transparency, and continuous improvement. · Proactively identify and resolve delivery impediments, coordinating cross-functionally to manage dependencies and resource constraints. · Monitor key delivery metrics—including on-time delivery, milestone achievement, release stability, and team velocity—and report progress to senior stakeholders. · Prepare the organisation for scale by strengthening delivery frameworks, enhancing team capabilities, and institutionalising best practices. Technical Oversight · Provide expert guidance on software engineering practices, system design, and solution implementation in alignment with group technology standards. · Ensure engineering outputs adhere to established architecture principles, integration patterns, and platform roadmaps. · Promote consistency and maturity in development processes, including source code management, testing coverage, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation. · Collaborate with central technology functions to evaluate emerging tools, methodologies, and operating models that enhance delivery efficiency and resilience. · Support talent development through mentoring, performance feedback, and identification of skilling needs within the engineering community. People Management · Lead, coach, and inspire a high-performing engineering team in Chennai, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning. · Oversee the full employee lifecycle, including onboarding, role integration, career development planning, performance management, and offboarding. · Conduct regular performance reviews in line with the Bank’s appraisal processes, providing constructive feedback, setting clear objectives, and identifying growth opportunities. · Support succession planning and talent development, recognising high potential individuals and preparing them for increased responsibility. · Promote diversity, equity, and inclusion within the team, ensuring fair treatment, open communication, and psychological safety. · Champion the firm’s values and behavioural expectations, addressing conduct and performance issues promptly and in accordance with HR policies. Client & Stakeholder Management · Serve as the principal representative for the India engineering function, building trusted relationships with regional and global delivery partners. · Align closely with IT, Product, and Delivery teams to ensure cohesive execution across portfolios and functional boundaries. · Communicate delivery status, risks, and strategic updates clearly and confidently to diverse audiences, including senior leadership. · Facilitate joint planning sessions, governance meetings, and prioritisation forums to balance competing demands and optimise outcomes. · Champion a collaborative, solution-oriented culture that values accountability, transparency, and client focus. Regulatory & Risk Management · Safeguard delivery integrity by enforcing compliance with the Bank’s Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), change control, and release management policies. · Embed strong risk and control disciplines within engineering workflows, ensuring traceability, audit readiness, and adherence to internal controls. · Partner actively with Technology Risk, Information Security, and Internal Audit to address findings, implement action plans, and strengthen control posture. · Ensure all developments meet regulatory expectations pertinent to financial services, particularly regarding data protection, access management, and resilient operations. · Maintain robust documentation practices and lead preparedness for audits, inspections, and regulatory reviews. SKILLS REQUIREMENTS OF THE POSITION We are looking for a proven technology leader with substantial experience in delivering complex transformations within structured, risk-sensitive environments—ideally within financial services or private banking. · At least 15-20 years of progressive experience in technology delivery, with significant exposure to digital transformation programmes. · Minimum of 8-10 years in a leadership capacity, managing teams of engineers or developers in hybrid (Agile/Waterfall) environments. · Solid understanding of software delivery governance, release management, and technology risk principles. · Demonstrated ability to lead through change, build high-performing teams, and operate effectively in matrixed organisations. · Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with fluency in English (written and spoken). · Background in wealth management or financial services is highly desirable. · Relevant qualifications in Computer Science, Engineering, or Business; postgraduate degrees or certifications (e.g., PMP, SAFe, PRINCE2, ITIL) are considered a plus. RANK APPLICABLE TO THE POSITION · D REPORTING LINE · Head of Digital Transformation APAC FURTHER INFORMATION · Region/Division: COO / Information Technology · Location: Chennai Pay: ₹5,000,000.00 - ₹6,000,000.00 per year Work Location: In person

This role drives standardization, reusable frameworks, best practices, and innovation within the Apriso Center of Excellence while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and digital manufacturing strategy. Key Responsibilities 1. CoE Strategy & Governance 2. Enterprise Solution Architecture Architect scalable, reusable Apriso solutions across manufacturing domains 3. Standardization & Reusability 4. Integration Architecture 5. Technology Leadership & Capability Building

role: Associate Director - Market Risk & Model Validation (10-17 yrs)
normalizedText: Associate Director - Market Risk & Model Validation (10-17 yrs) Black Turtle Bengaluru Experience: 10-17 Yrs Salary: Not disclosed Skills: Market Risk, Model Validation, Risk Management, Derivatives, Financial Modeling, Risk Modeling Job Title: Associate Director, MRM Validation Key Responsibilities: - Independently execute end-to-end model validations as dictated by the Global Model Risk Policy. This includes assessing model inputs, calculations, reporting outputs, conceptual soundness, data relevance, qualitative information, documentation, and implementation. - Design, develop, and execute tailored testing frameworks to identify risks and limitations. Develop and implement advanced validation methodologies and tools to enhance process efficiency and effectiveness. - Ensure the execution of model validation projects within the functional stream, guaranteeing timely delivery and high-quality work. Contribute to the continuous improvement of validation processes and suggest enhancements. - Lead discussions with model developers and business owners regarding validation outcomes, issues, and remediation actions, effectively defending validation conclusions when necessary. - Guide interactions with Group Internal Audit regarding model-related audits, MSIIs, and audit issues. - Participate in strategic initiatives and proactively suggest improvements. Provide support, guidance, and coaching to team members. - Ensure the effective implementation of Model Risk Management processes and methodologies. - Complete portfolio-level reviews to ensure consistency in the application of the model risk policy. Market risk VaR, FRTB, and Value at Risk models (Greek-based or Full Revaluation). 2. PFE modelling for XVA and Cross Value Adjustment (XVA) modelling. 3. Incremental Risk Charge (IRC) models. 4. Soft Skills: Deep understanding of financial products and markets. Ability to manage model risk across a large complex banking group. Experience managing multiple senior stakeholder relationships. Position: Sr. Executive – CRM Location: Pune Department: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Project: Luxury Segment – Kasturi Housing Company Description: Kasturi Housing is a luxury real estate brand based in Pune, India. With over 25 years of experience, the company has successfully delivered over 2 million sq. feet of prime real estate and is currently developing another 2 million square feet for residential purposes. Kasturi is known for its high standards of quality and creativity, and has received numerous awards and accolades for its exceptional planning and execution. Role Overview We are looking for a dynamic and customer-focused Sr. Executive – CRM to manage the post-sales customer journey for our high-end clientele. The ideal candidate will ensure a seamless experience from booking to possession, ensuring customer delight at every touch point. Key Responsibilities: Client Relationship Management Act as the single point of contact for all post-sales client interactions. Build and maintain strong relationships with high-net-worth individuals (HNIs) and luxury clients. Handle customer queries, complaints, and feedback with professionalism and empathy. Documentation & Coordination Coordinate all documentation related to sale agreements, registration, and possession. Ensure timely collection of payments as per the construction-linked plan. Liaise with internal departments (sales, legal, accounts, projects) for smooth execution of CRM activities. Customer Communication Regularly update clients about construction progress, demand letters, milestones, etc. Coordinate site visits, walkthroughs, and possession handovers with a high level of service excellence. System & Reporting Maintain and update CRM software (e.g., SAP). Generate reports on customer status, collection milestones, and pending issues. Possession & Handover Ensure smooth handover process including documentation, inspection, and snag-list closures. Manage final settlements and feedback collection at the time of possession. Requirements: Graduate/Postgraduate in Business Administration or a related field. 1–3 years of CRM experience in real estate (preferably in the luxury segment). Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong coordination, follow-up, and negotiation abilities. Well-versed with CRM tools and MS Office. Customer-first attitude with a polished and professional demeanor.

AmeriSave Mortgage Corp. has set the standard in online mortgage lending, with over $130 billion in funded loan volume. As one of the largest privately owned online mortgage lenders in the United States, our mission is to deliver beneficial, responsible home lending solutions with unwavering integrity, dedication, and excellence. We leverage cutting-edge technology, data-driven strategies, and proprietary platforms to create exceptional customer experiences and operational efficiency. As we continue investing in technology and innovation, we are expanding our global engineering footprint and building a world-class technology organization in India. What We’re Looking For: AmeriSave is seeking a visionary and hands-on Chief Technology Officer based in India to establish, build, and lead our India technology organization. This executive leader will be responsible for recruiting, developing, and scaling high-performing engineering teams while partnering closely with technology and business leaders in the United States. This role is ideal for a proven technology executive who has successfully built and scaled engineering teams within India for a U.S.-based organization. The successful candidate will provide strategic technology leadership while remaining deeply engaged in engineering execution, architecture, cloud infrastructure, security, AI initiatives, and organizational development. You will serve as a key bridge between AmeriSave's U.S. technology leadership team and the India engineering organization, ensuring alignment, collaboration, and delivery of critical technology initiatives. What You'll Do: Build & Scale the India Technology Organization Establish and lead AmeriSave's India technology center. Recruit, hire, mentor, and retain top engineering, infrastructure, AI, data, security, and technology leadership talent throughout India. Develop organizational structure, leadership pipelines, career paths, and employee development programs. Build a high-performance engineering culture centered on accountability, innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence. Global Engineering Leadership Partner closely with U.S.-based technology leaders, product leaders, architects, and business stakeholders. Lead distributed engineering teams delivering solutions across multiple time zones. Foster seamless collaboration between India and U.S. technology teams. Establish engineering best practices, delivery standards, and development processes. Software Engineering & Platform Ownership Lead teams responsible for designing, building, and maintaining AmeriSave's proprietary technology platforms. Drive engineering excellence, architecture governance, code quality, scalability, and software delivery. Oversee development of customer-facing and internal business applications supporting the mortgage lifecycle. Cloud Infrastructure & Technology Operations Partner with infrastructure teams supporting AmeriSave's Azure-based environment. Drive performance, scalability, cost optimization, monitoring, and operational reliability initiatives. Ensure engineering teams develop highly available and resilient applications. AI & Innovation Strategy Lead AI-driven innovation initiatives across software engineering and business operations. Identify opportunities for automation, machine learning, generative AI, and intelligent workflow optimization. Collaborate with U.S. leadership on the company's AI roadmap and execution strategy. Security & Risk Management Partner with information security, compliance, and risk management teams. Ensure engineering practices align with security standards, financial services regulations, and data privacy requirements. Promote a security-first culture across all technology teams. Executive Partnership Serve as a strategic technology advisor to executive leadership. Participate in long-term technology planning and workforce strategy. Communicate engineering performance, technology investments, risks, and opportunities to senior leadership. Budget & Resource Management Manage India technology staffing plans and operating budgets. Drive efficient resource allocation across engineering initiatives. Develop long-term workforce strategies supporting organizational growth. What You’ll Need: Executive Technology Leadership 15+ years of progressive technology leadership experience. 5+ years in an executive technology leadership role such as CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Technology, or Engineering Director. Proven experience leading large-scale software engineering organizations. Building Teams in India Demonstrated success establishing, scaling, and leading engineering organizations in India for U.S.-based companies. Extensive experience recruiting and developing high-performing engineering teams. Strong understanding of India's technology talent market and hiring landscape. Distributed Team Leadership Experience leading globally distributed teams across India and North America. Track record of building strong cross-functional partnerships across geographic regions. Ability to effectively manage communication and execution across multiple time zones. Technical Expertise Strong background in modern software engineering practices and architecture. Experience with cloud technologies, preferably Microsoft Azure. Knowledge of enterprise platforms, databases, APIs, and scalable application design. Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, observability, and infrastructure modernization initiatives. AI & Emerging Technologies Experience leading AI, automation, machine learning, or generative AI initiatives. Ability to translate emerging technologies into measurable business value. Leadership & Communication Exceptional executive presence and stakeholder management skills. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to influence leaders at all levels of the organization. Preferred Qualifications Technical Depth: Deep expertise in Java, TypeScript, Node.js, SQL, and React, with the ability to provide architectural leadership and make informed decisions across the full software development lifecycle. Hands-On Engineering Background: Built a career as a software engineer and technical leader, maintaining sufficient technical depth to challenge assumptions, evaluate solutions, and mentor senior engineering talent. Engineering Credibility: Respected by engineering teams for practical development experience and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business outcomes. Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field required. Master's degree preferred. Why Join AmeriSave? This is a rare opportunity to build and lead a strategically important global technology organization from the ground up. You will have significant influence over technology strategy, organizational growth, hiring decisions, engineering culture, and innovation initiatives while partnering directly with senior technology and business leaders in the United States. Join us as we build the next generation of digital mortgage technology and AI-powered customer experiences. Compensation Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience, qualifications, skills, and market conditions. In addition to base compensation, eligible employees may be considered for performance-based incentives and other company-sponsored programs, where applicable. Benefits Benefits are provided through AmeriSave's Employer of Record partner and may include: Statutory benefits required under applicable Indian law Paid time off and holidays Health and wellness benefits (where offered) Additional company-sponsored programs, subject to eligibility Employment Structure This position will be employed through Deel, AmeriSave's Employer of Record (EOR) partner in India. While Deel will serve as the legal employer for local payroll, benefits administration, and employment compliance purposes, the successful candidate will work exclusively for AmeriSave Mortgage Corporation, operate as a member of the AmeriSave leadership team, and perform services under AmeriSave's direction and management. Work Authorization Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India at the time of application and throughout their employment. AmeriSave and Deel reserve the right to verify employment eligibility and identity in accordance with applicable laws and company policies. Unless expressly stated otherwise, visa sponsorship and immigration sponsorship are not available for this position. Equal Opportunity Employer AmeriSave is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. Applicant Privacy Notice By submitting an application, you acknowledge that AmeriSave and Deel may collect, use, store, process, and transfer your personal information for legitimate recruitment, employment, compliance, and business purposes. Personal information provided during the recruitment process will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy laws. Candidate information will be used solely for recruitment-related purposes and may be shared with authorized service providers involved in the hiring process. Applicants may contact us regarding questions about the handling of their personal information or applicable privacy rights. Important Notice AmeriSave and its recruiting partners will never request payment, banking information, cryptocurrency, gift cards, or other fees as part of the application or hiring process. Candidates should report any suspicious communications claiming to represent AmeriSave. LinkedIn job posting guidelines prohibit employers from charging candidate fees or requesting inappropriate sensitive information during the application process.

Job description: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced professional to lead the Operations function of our NBFC. The Head of Operations will play a key strategic and executional role in ensuring smooth, compliant, and customer-centric operations across all verticals, including investment products, loan products, deposit products, and insurance offerings. The ideal candidate must be well-versed with RBI compliance and operational best practices in the financial services space. Strategic Operations Management: Lead and oversee day-to-day operations across lending, investment, deposits, and insurance products. Develop and implement efficient, scalable processes to support business growth while ensuring regulatory compliance and customer satisfaction. Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure full compliance with RBI guidelines and other regulatory requirements governing NBFC operations. Collaborate with compliance and risk teams to mitigate operational risks and enforce internal controls. Product Operations Oversight Manage back-office operations for: Loan Products: Personal, business, secured/unsecured loans. Investment Products: NCDs, Sub-debts, etc. Deposit Products: Fixed deposits, recurring deposits, etc. Insurance Products: Life, general, and health insurance processing and servicing. Technology & Automation: Work closely with the technology team to implement digital transformation initiatives. Champion automation and process optimization projects to improve TAT and cost-efficiency. Customer Experience & Service Delivery: Oversee client onboarding, servicing, disbursals, renewals, and query resolution. Establish SLAs and ensure high-quality service delivery across all touchpoints. Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and build a high-performing operations team. Foster a culture of accountability, excellence, and compliance. Audit & Reporting: Liaise with auditors (internal/external) and ensure timely closure of audit findings. Prepare and present periodic reports to senior leadership and regulatory bodies as required. Job Category: Management Job Type: Full Time Job Location: Kerala Branch: Thrissur

role: Associate Vice President, Strategic Initiatives - India
normalizedText: About Impact Investment Exchange (IIX) IIX (Impact Investment Exchange) is a Singapore-headquartered pioneer in impact investing — building the infrastructure where capital markets meet sustainable development. Over 15+ years, IIX has built the sustainable investing market across four pillars: capital mobilisation, enterprise technical assistance, data and impact measurement, and global advocacy. Our flagship initiatives include the Women's Livelihood Bond™ Series (7 listed bonds and growing), IIX Values™ (impact verification technology), IIX Intelligence™ (a global data hub benchmarking MSMEs on ESG, gender, and climate performance), and the Orange Movement™ — a new asset class at the intersection of gender equality and climate action. Together, these represent nearly US$1.5 billion in capital mobilised, 185 million+ lives positively impacted, 1.9 million metric tons of carbon avoided, and 116,000+ data points collected on sustainable MSMEs. Recognised by the Oslo Business for Peace Award and the UN Global Climate Action Award, IIX is a lean, mission-obsessed team. Everyone here wears multiple hats, moves fast, and cares deeply about the work. If that energises you, you will thrive at IIX. About the role We are seeking a highly driven and independent professional to join the CEO's Office, working on Strategic Initiatives that are high-priority, cross-cutting, and central to organizational direction. This role requires a rare combination of strategic thinking, strong execution, and professional maturity. The individual will operate as an extension of leadership: managing new initiatives, engaging external partners, and translating high-level priorities into structured action. The Associate Vice President in the Strategic Initiatives - CEO's team is a high-impact, high-ownership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of new concept development, organizational strategy, and cross-functional execution. You will serve as an extension of the CEO - driving strategic initiatives, enabling high-quality decision-making, and amplifying IIX's voice in the global impact investing space. This is not a traditional support role. It is designed for an intellectually curious, execution-oriented professional who can navigate ambiguity, operate with minimal hand-holding, and switch hats across projects. Key Responsibilities CEO & CEO's Office Support Support the Strategic Initiatives team and the CEO's Office in managing and delivering on high-priority workstreams and organisational commitments. Prepare high-quality written outputs — briefing notes, presentations, reports, and correspondence — for the CEO's internal and external engagements. Support client and stakeholder engagement: preparing meeting briefs, participating in meetings, and managing follow-ups with rigour. Contribute to IIX's research outputs, knowledge products, and thought leadership pieces linked to strategic priorities. Organisational Strategy Assist in translating strategic directions into structured workstreams, trackers, and action plans that teams can execute against. Coordinate across internal teams to align inputs, monitor progress, and surface blockers on organisation-wide priorities. Support the preparation of strategy documents, organisational planning materials, and internal reporting. Help the CEO's Office maintain a clear line of sight across IIX's evolving portfolio of initiatives and commitments. New Concept & Initiative Development Support the scoping and development of new ideas and initiatives emerging from the CEO's Office — from first principles to structured proposal. Structure early-stage concepts into proposals, frameworks, or workplans ready for internal review or external pitching. Conduct research and analysis to inform the development of new programmes, products, and strategic directions across sectors. Identify new markets, partnership opportunities, and funding mechanisms that advance IIX's mission in sustainable and inclusive finance. Business Development & External Partnerships Support the identification and cultivation of new institutional partnerships, donor relationships, and co-investment opportunities. Develop proposals, pitch decks, and programme frameworks for new business opportunities aligned with IIX's strategy. Help build and maintain IIX's external profile through targeted engagement with development finance institutions, impact investors, and multilateral organisations. Track IIX's partnership pipeline and ensure follow-through on key relationships and commitments. What We're Looking For Required Qualifications & Experience Minimum 7-10years of professional experience in a top-tier consulting firm, financial institution, development finance organisation, or impact-focused environment. Those with more years of experience may be considered for Associate VP position. Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, International Development, Public Policy, or a related discipline. Demonstrated ability to develop high-quality written outputs — proposals, grant applications, research reports, briefing notes, or strategy documents. Strong analytical and structured thinking skills — able to work with both qualitative frameworks and quantitative data. Excellent written and verbal communication; able to distil complex ideas into clear, compelling narratives for senior audiences. Proven ability to operate as a self-starter with minimal supervision, managing multiple workstreams under time pressure. Experience supporting or managing components of projects or initiatives in complex, multi-stakeholder environments. Preferred & Desired Demonstrated knowledge of gender equality, social inclusion, or climate action — particularly with an intersectional lens. Familiarity with inclusive finance, impact investing, blended finance, or ESG frameworks. Cross-sectoral exposure spanning climate, infrastructure, development finance, or impact capital markets. International work experience — IIX's work spans Asia, Africa, and beyond, and comfort with diverse geographies matters. The Person Intellectually curious — you ask the questions others haven't thought to ask, and you go deep before you go wide. Execution-oriented — you close the loop, follow through, and take pride in the quality of everything that leaves your hands. Comfortable with ambiguity — you can structure a problem from scratch and move forward without needing every answer upfront. Genuinely mission-driven — you believe finance can be a powerful force for good, and that belief shapes how you work. Mature and professionally grounded — you exercise sound judgment, respect organisational hierarchy, and know when to lead and when to support. A collaborator and a self-starter in equal measure — you work well across teams and take full ownership of what's yours. The PREM Framework At IIX, we don't just hire for skills — we hire for values. Our PREM framework defines what it means to be an IIX team member: P Passionate Deep commitment to IIX's mission; intrinsically motivated; purpose-driven in their work. R Resilient Adaptable under pressure; bounces back from setbacks; thrives in ambiguity and fast-changing environments. E Equitable Champions fairness, inclusion, and belonging; walks the talk on equity in every interaction. M Maverick Innovative, bold thinker; challenges the status quo; brings an entrepreneurial spirit to problem-solving. Why IIX Work with the Head of Strategic Initiatives team in CEO on IIX's most consequential new projects — the exposure and responsibility here are unmatched for someone at your career stage. Be part of a movement, not just a job — IIX's work on Orange Capital, gender-climate finance, and impact data is reshaping what finance can do for society. High-trust, lean team environment — minimal bureaucracy, maximum ownership. Your ideas will be heard and your contributions will be visible. Access to a global network of development finance institutions, impact investors, and multilateral organisations across Asia, Africa, and beyond. A culture that takes PREM values seriously — you will be seen, heard, and valued for who you are and what you bring. How to Apply To apply, please send your CV and a brief cover letter. In your cover note, tell us about a moment when you turned an ambiguous problem into a clear plan of action — and what happened next. We read every application. IIX is an equal opportunity employer.

Chief Operating Officer (COO) Location: Mohali, PunjabExperience: 8–12+ YearsCompensation: ₹4–5 Lakhs per MonthEmployment Type: Full-Time | On-Site About the Role We are looking for an exceptional Chief Operating Officer (COO) to lead the overall operational and commercial execution of a premium, celebrity-led saree brand. The COO will be the operational backbone of the business, responsible for translating the brand vision into a highly structured, scalable and profitable organisation. The role will oversee teams, processes, product operations, supply chain, inventory, production, e-commerce operations, financial performance and overall execution. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in building and scaling consumer-facing businesses, preferably within fashion, apparel, D2C, lifestyle or premium consumer brands. Key Responsibilities Take ownership of the company's overall operations and execution. Translate business vision and strategy into clear operational plans and measurable objectives. Lead and manage cross-functional teams across merchandising, production, e-commerce, marketing, finance, supply chain and operations. Build scalable systems, SOPs, reporting structures and performance-management mechanisms. Oversee end-to-end product operations, including sourcing, production, inventory, warehousing and fulfilment. Drive operational efficiency, profitability and cost optimisation. Work closely with the merchandising and production teams to ensure collections are delivered within timelines and quality standards. Oversee inventory planning and ensure optimal stock availability without excessive working capital. Work closely with the e-commerce and marketing teams to align product availability with campaigns, launches and demand. Monitor P&L, budgets, margins, working capital and overall business performance. Build and manage relationships with manufacturers, suppliers, logistics partners and other key vendors. Establish KPIs and ensure accountability across departments. Identify operational bottlenecks and implement effective solutions. Work closely with senior leadership on business expansion, new categories, launches and growth initiatives. Ensure the brand maintains a premium customer experience across all touchpoints. Lead crisis management and ensure business continuity during high-demand periods or operational challenges. Candidate Profile 8–12+ years of experience in senior operations/business leadership roles. Strong experience in D2C, fashion, apparel, lifestyle, luxury, retail or consumer brands. Proven experience managing multiple departments and large cross-functional teams. Strong understanding of P&L, inventory, supply chain, production and business operations. Demonstrated experience in scaling a business or brand. MBA from a reputed institution preferred. Excellent leadership, negotiation, analytical and decision-making skills. Strong commercial acumen with a results-driven approach. Experience working with founders, public figures, premium brands or high-visibility businesses will be an advantage. Ideal Candidate A hands-on, commercially strong operator who can bring structure, discipline and scalability to a fast-growing brand while maintaining the premium positioning and quality expected from a celebrity-led business. Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per month Work Location: In person

HR Transformation & Operations Eversub Gurugram Experience: 10-20 Yrs Salary: Not disclosed Skills: HR Operations, HR MIS, Payroll Management, Employee Life Cycle, Employee Data Management, HRIS, HR Information System, HR Analytics Job Title: Manager / Senior Manager HR Transformation & HR Technology Location: Gurugram, Haryana Function: Human Resources Reporting To: Chief People Officer Experience: 1015 Years Industry Preference: Retail | QSR | FMCG | Logistics | Manufacturing | High-Growth / Large Workforce Organizations Job Summary We are looking for a technology-first HR Transformation professional to lead HR digital transformation, process excellence and HR technology initiatives across the organization. The role will be responsible for redesigning HR processes, driving automation and digitalization, managing HR technology platforms, strengthening HR data governance and analytics, and improving employee experience across the employee lifecycle . The role will work closely with HR, Operations, Technology and Business teams to deliver scalable, efficient and data-driven HR solutions. Key Responsibilities 1. HR Transformation & Process Excellence Lead HR transformation and process improvement initiatives. Review, redesign and standardize employee lifecycle processes. Identify manual processes and implement automation and workflow solutions. Drive digitalization to improve efficiency, scalability and employee experience. 2. HR Technology / HRMS Own and manage HR technology platforms and applications. Drive HRMS enhancements, upgrades, integrations and system improvements. Partner with IT teams and technology vendors for implementation and issue resolution. Ensure HR systems remain aligned with business and workforce requirements. 3. Employee Lifecycle & Data Management Digitize and optimize processes covering hiring, onboarding, transfers, promotions, employee master data, role changes and exits. Establish controls for HR data accuracy and integrity. Improve employee experience through simplified digital HR processes. 4. HR Operations & Compliance Strengthen governance for large/frontline workforce management. Ensure adherence to labour laws, wage regulations and statutory requirements. Partner with Operations and HR teams to ensure compliant and practical HR processes. 5. Payroll & Compensation Process Strengthen payroll input processes, validation and controls. Drive automation and process improvements in payroll workflows. Minimize payroll errors through effective data governance. 6. HR Analytics & Reporting Build HR dashboards, scorecards and management reports. Analyze workforce data to identify trends, risks and opportunities. Develop analytics-based solutions for: Attrition analysis Exit NPS Employee distance mapping Workforce productivity Employee engagement Workforce planning 7. HR System Integration & Data Governance Manage integrations between HRMS and related business applications. Ensure accurate employee data flow across systems. Establish validation controls for joining, transfers, exits, employee master changes and organizational changes. Drive data quality and reporting reliability. 8. Change Management & User Adoption Act as escalation point for HR technology and process issues. Train HR teams, frontline managers and business stakeholders. Drive adoption of new HR systems and processes through structured change management. Ensure timely resolution of user issues. Key Skills / Keywords HR Transformation | HR Digital Transformation | HR Technology | HRMS | HRIS | HR Automation | HR Process Excellence | HR Operations | Employee Lifecycle Management | HR Analytics | People Analytics | HR Dashboards | Data Governance | Payroll | Workforce Management | System Integration | Change Management | Process Re-engineering | Digital HR | Project Management | Vendor Management | Labour Laws | HR Technology Implementation Candidate Profile MBA / PGDM in HR, Business Administration or related discipline. 1015 years of progressive HR experience . Strong experience in HR Operations, HR Technology and HR Transformation . Experience in implementing HR systems, automation and process transformation projects . Strong understanding of Indian labour laws, wage regulations and statutory compliance. Strong analytical and data management capabilities. Experience with HRMS/HRIS, payroll, reporting and dashboarding tools . Experience managing technology vendors and cross-functional projects. Candidates from Retail, QSR, FMCG, Logistics, Manufacturing or other large workforce environments preferred. What Success Looks Like Increased HR process automation and digital adoption Reduced manual interventions and process turnaround time Improved employee experience Improved HR data accuracy and reporting Successful HR technology implementation and stabilization Strong compliance and process governance Better workforce analytics and business insights High adoption and satisfaction with HR systems

role: Chief Technology Officer - Digital Lending (15-28 yrs)
normalizedText: Chief Technology Officer - Digital Lending (15-28 yrs) PMS Consulting Gurugram Experience: 15-28 Yrs Salary: Not disclosed Skills: Technical Architect, IT Jobs in BFSI, Digital Transformation, CTO, IT Strategy Role Overview: Define and execute the company's long-term technology roadmap and align technology strategy with business, lending and growth objectives. Advise CEO/MD and senior management on technology investments and emerging technologies. Drive technology modernization and digital transformation. Key Responsibilities: - Lead technology for LOS, LMS, Collections, CRM, ERP and digital lending platforms. - Build scalable customer onboarding and digital loan journeys. - Manage integrations with KYC providers, credit bureaus, GSTN, banks, payment gateways and other financial APIs. - Improve automation across loan origination, underwriting, disbursement, repayment and collections. Architecture & Infrastructure: - Design scalable enterprise and application architecture. - Lead cloud strategy across AWS / Azure / GCP. - Ensure high availability, scalability, performance and business continuity. - Establish DevOps, CI/CD, API and microservices best practices. Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance: - Ensure technology systems comply with applicable RBI IT, cybersecurity, data protection and regulatory requirements. - Strengthen information-security controls, monitoring and audit mechanisms. - Work closely with CISO, Risk, Compliance and Internal Audit. - Establish effective DR, BCP and incident-response frameworks. Data, AI & Analytics: - Drive adoption of AI/ML, advanced analytics and automation. - Enable data-driven credit decisioning, fraud detection and customer risk assessment. - Build robust data platforms, dashboards and MIS systems. Team & Vendor Management: - Build and lead a high-performing technology organization. - Manage engineering, infrastructure, product technology, data and IT operations teams. - Manage technology vendors, system integrators and strategic partners. - Define SLAs, KPIs and technology governance mechanisms. Technology Governance & Budget: - Own the technology budget and optimize technology expenditure. - Establish IT governance, SDLC, project management and technology-risk frameworks. - Ensure timely delivery of critical technology projects. - Present technology strategy, risks and performance to senior management/Board.

role: Associate Director - Markets - CHS - CBS - C&I - BD & CE Leadership
normalizedText: Associate Director - Markets - CHS - CBS - C&I - BD & CE Leadership EY Mumbai Experience: 10-20 Yrs Salary: Not disclosed Skills: administration, agile, architecture, business development, business management, cbs, communication skills, consumer products, customer engagement, customer success, data science, digital transformation, enterprise sales, healthcare, legal The opportunity : Associate Director-CHS-Markets-CBS - C&I - BD & CE Leadership - Mumbai CHS : CHS consists of Consumer Products and Healthcare sectors. Consumer products largely entail, Retail and Agri business. Companies in this sector meet the demands of consumers all around the world, every day; providing everything from agricultural crops to food, clothes, durables and retail experiences. We help clients to capture new sources of profitable growth, rethinking how and where they bring value to consumers, today and into the future. Incumbents need to shift their focus from protecting what they have to creating what they need to become. The Health Sciences & Wellness architecture brings together a worldwide network of professionals to build data-centric approaches to customer engagement and improved outcomes. To retain relevancy in todays digitally focused, data-infused ecosystem, all participants in the sector must rethink their business practices, including capital strategy, partnering and the creation of patient-centric operating models. CBS - C&I - BD & CE Leadership : Our Markets team focuses on providing account teams with the support they need to help drive revenue growth. Our "account-centric" approach to serving clients starts with understanding their business and providing tools and enablers to provide consistency on how we identify and align our services and solutions to our clients' most pressing issues. We deliver services through one or more of our four global service lines: Assurance, Consulting, Strategy and Transactions and Tax. Our Markets team comprises of Business Development and Brand Media & Communication (BMC). By adopting EY methodologies, executing on guidance, and leveraging tools and strategic programs, we bring the necessary rigor to our engagements. And by accessing our latest EY insights, solutions and client conversation tools, we have more meaningful conversations with our clients to help shape their thinking and generate additional value creation. The role involves working with enterprise customers, understanding business challenges, positioning SAP-led solutions, and supporting end-to-end sales cycles across industries. Candidates should possess strong communication skills, business acumen, relationship management capability, and a passion for technology consulting and enterprise sales. Skills and attributes To qualify for the role you must have Qualification Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science Bachelor of Technology in Mechanical Engineering Bachelor of Engineering in Electrical Bachelor of Commerce Bachelor of Business Administration Master of Engineering in Electronics Master of Science in Data Science Master of Commerce Master of Business Administration Experience Customer Success Management (3+ years) SAP Sales professional RISE with SAP, SAP Solution expert What we look for People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Vice President of Product Development Position Type: Executive Leadership Functional Areas: Product Development / Product Strategy / R&D / Product Innovation / Commercialization Reporting to: CEO, President, Chief Product Officer (CPO), or CTO I. Role Summary We are seeking a Vice President of Product Development with extensive experience in product development, R&D management, product strategy, technological innovation, and commercialization. This role is responsible for overseeing the company's product development ecosystem, translating corporate strategy, customer needs, and market opportunities into product roadmaps, and leading cross-functional teams through the entire product lifecycle—from conceptual design to official launch and continuous iteration. The VP of Product Development must collaborate closely with the CPO, CTO, CMO, as well as sales, customer success, and operations teams, ensuring that product development direction aligns with market demands, customer value, and corporate business objectives. II. Key Responsibilities 1. Product Development Strategy Formulate the company's product development strategy; Establish medium- to long-term product development plans; Determine product development priorities based on corporate strategy; Develop product roadmaps; Balance customer needs, market opportunities, and technical capabilities; Ensure product development aligns with the company's overall strategy. 2. Product Roadmap Management Develop product roadmaps; Manage the product lifecycle; Prioritize product features and release versions; Adjust development plans in response to market changes; Establish mechanisms for reviewing product requirements; Ensure products are developed and launched according to schedule. 3. Product Requirements and Market Analysis Analyze customer needs and industry trends; Establish customer feedback loops with sales and customer success teams; Research competitor products; Identify new product opportunities; Translate market needs into product requirements; Drive product-market fit. 4. Product R&D Management Lead product development and R&D teams; Manage product managers, product designers, and relevant R&D personnel; Establish standardized product development processes; Optimize the allocation of R&D resources; Oversee product development progress; Ensure product quality and delivery efficiency. 5. Cross-functional Product Development Coordinate the following teams to jointly execute product development: Product Engineering Design Data / AI Marketing Sales Customer Success Operations Establish a comprehensive cross-functional collaboration mechanism spanning from product concept to commercialization. 6. Product Innovation Establish a product innovation mechanism; Monitor technology trends such as AI, data analytics, cloud computing, and blockchain; Evaluate the application of new technologies within products; Drive the development of new products and features; Initiate product innovation projects; Enhance the company's product competitiveness. 7. Product Launch and Commercialization Formulate product launch plans; Develop go-to-market strategies in collaboration with product marketing teams; Support product positioning and business model design; Coordinate product launch preparations; Create product launch checklists; Track post-launch market performance. 8. Product Quality and Continuous Improvement Establish product quality management mechanisms; Monitor product defects and customer feedback; Define product performance metrics; Drive continuous product iteration; Analyze product usage data; Improve product stability and user experience. 9. Product Data Analysis Establish a product analytics framework; Analyze product usage rates and feature adoption rates; Monitor key product KPIs; Analyze user behavior; Identify product optimization opportunities through data; Provide data-driven support for product decision-making. 10. Team Building and Talent Management Build a global product development organization; Recruit and develop senior product talent; Establish a product management talent pipeline; Define team performance metrics; Create product development training systems; Foster an innovative, efficient, and customer-centric product culture. III. Qualifications Education Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Product Management, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field; MBA, MS, or advanced education in technology/management is preferred. Work Experience 20+ years of experience in product development, product management, R&D, or technology-related roles; 10+ years of experience in senior product or R&D management; Experience as VP of Product Development, VP of Product, Head of Product, Senior Director of Product, or at an equivalent level; Experience with enterprise, B2B, SaaS, or complex technical products; Experience managing the full product lifecycle; Experience in global product development or managing cross-regional teams is preferred. 4. Core Competencies product development Product Development Product Management Product Lifecycle Management Product Roadmap Product Requirements Product Launch product strategy Product Strategy Product Portfolio Strategy Product-Market Fit Market Analysis Competitive Analysis Product Innovation Technology and R&D Technology Strategy Engineering Collaboration Agile Development Software Development AI/Data Products Digital Transformation commercialization Go-to-Market Strategy Product Commercialization Pricing Strategy Market Adoption Customer Acquisition Revenue Growth Senior Management Executive Leadership Cross-functional Leadership Global Team Management Strategic Planning Resource Allocation Stakeholder Management Benefits: Health insurance Paid time off Work from home Work Location: Remote
