normalizedText: Everest Group- Research & Advisory - Practice Director -HLS Everest Business Advisory India Hybrid - Gurugram(Sector 47), Bengaluru(Manayata Tech Park) Experience: 5-9 Yrs Salary: Not disclosed Skills: Project Delivery, Healthcare Consulting, Strategy Consulting, Management Consulting, Thought Leadership, Stakeholder Management, Market Intelligence, Payer Provider Transformation, Pharma Technology, Healthcare Analytics, Digital Health MBA from a reputed B-school preferred engineering or life sciences graduates with strong consulting backgrounds may also be considered Between 6 to9 years of experience in consulting,research,advisory,or professional services,preferably within healthcare and life sciences.

Director/Associate Director - Business Development (Oil & Gas) Riverforest Connections Hybrid - Gurugram, Mumbai (All Areas) Experience: 12-20 Yrs Salary: Not disclosed Skills: Business Development, Sales, Lead Generation, Client Relationship Management, Revenue Expansion ROLE SUMMARY The role requires a seasoned professional with deep industry expertise, strong consulting acumen, and business development capabilities to drive strategic engagements with leading upstream, midstream, and downstream players. In particular, focus areas include crude oil, natural gas, LNG, pipelines/ terminals and city gas distribution. Energy transition linekd areas including green hydrogen/ ammonia, compressed bio gas, CCUS focus etc. would also be areas of priority. The Practice Leader & Director will be responsible for revenue growth, profitability, client relationship management, project delivery, team leadership and franchise building. The candidate would ensure impactful solutions in areas such as strategy/ business plans, feasibility studies, M&A/ due diligence, bid advisory, transaction advisory, policymaking and government advisory and digital transformation. The role involves working with private entities, government agencies (Central/ State), financial institutions, and multilaterals. This is a high-visibility leadership role, ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced consulting environment and is passionate about solving complex industry challenges while driving commercial success.

evidence.quote: CEO and executive team on marketing performance

normalizedText: We are seeking an experienced and visionary Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) to lead our marketing department and drive the company's marketing strategy. The CMO will be responsible for developing and executing marketing initiatives, building brand awareness, and achieving business growth objectives. Key Responsibilities: Develop and communicate a clear marketing vision and strategy aligned with company goals and objectives. Define target markets, customer segments, and positioning strategies. Recruit, manage, and mentor a high-performing marketing team, including professionals in areas such as digital marketing, branding, content, and PR. Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Manage and enhance the company's brand identity and image. Ensure brand consistency across all marketing channels and touchpoints. Oversee the planning, development, and execution of marketing campaigns across digital and traditional channels. Measure and analyze campaign effectiveness. Conduct market research to identify trends, customer needs, and competitive opportunities. Gather and analyze customer insights to inform marketing strategies. Develop and execute digital marketing strategies, including SEO, SEM, social media, email marketing, and content marketing. Utilize data and analytics to optimize digital marketing efforts. Collaborate with product teams to develop effective product marketing strategies and go-to-market plans. Ensure alignment between product positioning and customer needs. Manage public relations efforts, including media relations, press releases, and crisis communications. Build and maintain relationships with media outlets and influencers. Develop and manage the marketing budget, allocating resources effectively to meet marketing goals. Ensure cost-effective marketing operations. Provide regular reports to the CEO and executive team on marketing performance, achievements, and challenges. Communicate marketing strategies and priorities to stakeholders. Qualifications and Skills: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (Master's degree or MBA is preferred). Proven experience as a CMO or in a senior marketing leadership role, with a track record of driving marketing strategy and achieving business growth. Strong understanding of marketing principles, including branding, digital marketing, and product marketing. Exceptional leadership and team-building skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate marketing teams. Analytical and strategic thinking, with a focus on data-driven decision-making. Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities, with the capacity to engage with stakeholders at all levels. Financial acumen and budget management experience. Knowledge of industry trends, market research, and customer behavior. Crisis management and public relations skills. Benefits: Competitive compensation package and executive-level perks. Opportunities for professional development and career advancement. A dynamic and collaborative work environment. The chance to lead marketing innovation and drive business growth. Job Type: Full-time / Freelance / Part-time / Contract Location: Chandigarh (U.T.) India Chief Marketing Officer If this job matches your profile, we encourage you to share your CV and become part of our dynamic team, where innovation and growth are at the core of everything we do. If you think this opportunity could benefit others, feel free to share it on your social media—because sharing is caring!

role: Yes Madam - Engineering Vice President (10-17 yrs)
normalizedText: Yes Madam - Engineering Vice President (10-17 yrs) Yes Madam Noida Experience: 10-17 Yrs Salary: Not disclosed Skills: System Architecture, Engineering Management, IT Product Architecture, Cloud, API, Distributed Systems, IT Roadmap About YesMadam : YesMadam is a tech-enabled at-home beauty and wellness platform, serving millions of customers across multiple cities in India. We are building a technology-led consumer platform that connects customers with professional beauty and wellness services through a seamless digital experience. As we scale across cities, we are looking for a VP Engineering to lead our engineering organization and build a highly scalable, reliable and high-performing technology platform. Role Overview : We are looking for a strategic and hands-on VP Engineering who will own the overall engineering organization, technology execution and engineering strategy. The ideal candidate will combine strong technical depth, product thinking, business understanding and people leadership. You will work closely with the founders, product and business leadership to translate company objectives into scalable technology solutions and ensure fast, reliable product delivery. Key Responsibilities : - Own engineering planning, execution, delivery and organizational effectiveness. - Establish engineering standards, development practices and technical governance. - Build a high-performance engineering culture focused on ownership, quality and speed. - Own the overall technology architecture and long-term technical roadmap. - Design and scale highly available, secure and reliable consumer-facing platforms. - Partner closely with Product, Design, Data and Business teams to deliver high-impact initiatives. - Own application performance, availability, scalability and reliability. - Build, structure and scale the engineering organization as the business grows. - Work directly with founders and senior leadership on technology and business priorities. Required Qualifications : - 10+ years of experience in software/product engineering. - 2+ years of experience in senior engineering leadership roles such as VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, Engineering Director or equivalent. - Proven experience managing and scaling large engineering organizations. - Strong understanding of system architecture, distributed systems, APIs, databases and cloud technologies. - Hands-on experience with AWS or other major cloud platforms. - Experience building and scaling consumer-facing web/mobile applications. Preferred Experience : - Experience in B2C, consumer internet, marketplace, e-commerce, hyperlocal or app-based businesses. - Experience scaling technology platforms across multiple cities/markets. - Experience building engineering organizations during a high-growth phase. What Success Looks Like : - Faster and more predictable product delivery. - Improved platform scalability and reliability. - Strong engineering leadership and team retention. - Strong alignment between Engineering, Product and Business teams.

InMobi Advertising is a global technology leader helping marketers win the moments that matter. Our advertising platform reaches over 2 billion people across 150+ countries and turns real-time context into business outcomes, delivering results grounded in privacy-first principles. Trusted by 30,000+ brands and leading publishers, InMobi is where intelligence, creativity, and accountability converge. By combining lock screens, apps, TVs, and the open web with AI and machine learning, we deliver receptive attention, precise personalization, and measurable impact. Through Glance AI, we are shaping AI Commerce, reimagining the future of e-commerce with inspiration-led discovery and shopping. Designed to seamlessly integrate into everyday consumer technology, Glance AI transforms every screen into a gateway for instant, personal, and joyful discovery. Spanning diverse categories such as fashion, beauty, travel, accessories, home décor, pets, and beyond, Glance AI delivers deeply personalized shopping experiences. With rich first-party data and unparalleled consumer access, it harnesses InMobi's global scale, insights, and targeting capabilities to create high impact, performance driven shopping journeys for brands worldwide. Recognized as a Great Place to Work, and by MIT Technology Review, Fast Company's Top 10 Innovators, and more, InMobi is a workplace where bold ideas create global impact. Backed by investors including SoftBank, Kleiner Perkins, and Sherpalo Ventures, InMobi has offices across San Mateo, New York, London, Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Jakarta, Bengaluru and beyond. At InMobi Advertising, you'll have the opportunity to shape how billions of users connect with content, commerce, and brands worldwide. To learn more, visit www.inmobi.com What you will be doing? We are seeking an experienced Manager of Product Marketing to lead our global product marketing initiatives for InMobi's Performance DSP. In this high-impact role, you will develop and execute go-to-market strategies, product positioning, and messaging that distinguish InMobi's Performance DSP in the competitive mobile ad tech landscape. Your focus will be on scaling our messaging globally as you manage product launches, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and create compelling sales and marketing materials. Your contribution will be instrumental in shaping InMobi's demand-side product marketing strategy, driving market leadership, and contributing to our rapid growth. In this role, you will help position InMobi's Performance DSP as the leading platform for mobile in-app performance advertising. You will provide strategic marketing leadership focusing on key mobile performance areas like App Install campaigns, User Acquisition, Retention & Re-engagement, Events optimization, Creatives, Targeting, and Cross-platform Attribution, all while supporting and shaping the broader product strategy and go-to-market initiatives for our Performance DSP. The Impact You'll Make Develop market positioning, materials, processes, and products that differentiate InMobi's Performance DSP offerings (including sales enablement tools, presentations, case studies, whitepapers, videos, and thought leadership). Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Product teams to create a consistent and compelling product message that effectively promotes InMobi's Performance DSP. Work closely with the sales training team to prepare sellers for client meetings and industry events focused on Performance DSP solutions. Incubate alpha and beta Performance DSP products/features from launch to scale for major customers and sales support teams. Serve as the liaison between teams to bridge the gap between client feedback and InMobi's Performance DSP product development, enabling adaptations to improve our products and market responsiveness. Key Responsibilities: - Develop and execute the corporate communications strategy aligned with the organization's business objectives and growth agenda. - Lead internal, external, executive, and leadership communications to enhance employee engagement, organizational alignment, and brand reputation. - Partner with C-suite executives to develop communication plans, key messaging, speeches, presentations, town halls, leadership announcements, and change communication initiatives. - Lead communications for strategic business initiatives, organizational transformation, mergers & acquisitions, restructuring, and change management programs. - Develop employer branding and thought leadership campaigns across digital, social media, and industry platforms to strengthen the organization's market presence. - Collaborate with HR, Marketing, CSR, DE&I, and business leaders to deliver integrated communication campaigns supporting talent, culture, and business priorities. - Establish communication governance, editorial standards, content strategy, and communication effectiveness metrics. - Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing communications team while managing communication budgets and agency partnerships. normalizedText: Team Lead- Digital Marketing/Head of Marketing (AI & Digital Delivery) – B2B Marketing AgencyRole OverviewBlufig is seeking an ambitious, forward-thinking Head of Marketing to lead our digital delivery organization and pioneer our next phase of AI-driven growth. role: Senior HR PMO & AI Enablement Manager
normalizedText: Senior HR PMO & AI Enablement Manager Axa Xl Gurugram, Bengaluru Experience: 6-10 Yrs Salary: Not disclosed Skills: ai, hr, compliance, project manager, hrbp, architecture, project management, use cases, stakeholder management, change management, risk management, workforce planning, organizational design, relationship management, legal, legal compliance The Senior HR PMO AI Enablement Manager is accountable for translating the enterprise AI HR transformation strategy into remit-specific workforce approaches and for shaping, deploying, and enabling their adoption across Claims, Legal Compliance, and Global Operations. As Senior Manager, you will be a driver of AI-enabled initiatives, not just a project manager. You will draft playbooks, define KPIs, manage stakeholder alignment, and coordinate with the DPO, IT, and business units. You will serve as a strategic PMO and enablement hub, supporting HRs response to transformation by structuring thinking, connecting initiatives, and translating complexity into clear workforce narratives, decision frameworks, and coordinated HR actions. You will integrate inputs across AI use cases, workforce impact, Orion skills, organizational design, HR capability uplift, change enablement. What youll be doing What will your essential responsibilities include HR AI Enablement Structure and orchestrate people impact responses to AI transformation initiatives across Claims, Global Operations, and Legal Compliance. Partner with business, AI, and transformation leaders to translate AI use cases into workforce implications (roles, skills, organization). Work closely with the AI HR Taskforce (including HR Workforce Planning Transformation) to connect AI initiatives with workforce implications and HR activity into a coherent picture. Shape and apply HR approaches based on taskforce outputs within the remit, ensuring consistency, scalability, and practical application. Design and maintain practical HR frameworks to assess AI impact on work, roles, capacity, and skills; contribute to playbooks, templates, and governance materials. KPI framework: develop concrete KPIs per use case and for the overall program (adoption rates, time-to-value, learning time, productivity impact, cross-functional collaboration). Workforce Impact, Skills Organization Design Contribute to the evolution of organizational design and job architecture Structure options and scenarios to support informed decision-making as roles, skills, and work evolve. Build capability through exposure to live cases and co-design of targeted evolutions; avoid end-to-end ownership to enable rapid learning and iteration. Facilitation Capability Enablement Design and facilitate HRBP and crossR sessions; lead business workshops on AI impact, humanAI collaboration, and role evolution. Act as a connector across HRBPs, COEs, HR Transformation, and enterprise initiatives. Equip HRBPs with practical playbooks, tools, and frameworks to support assured and composed engagement with leaders on AI use cases. Change Management Adoption Roll out a people-centric change approach for AI-driven transformation; embed change management early and align with ESS and global functions for sustained adoption. Strategic PMO HR Orchestration Support Provide strategic PMO and orchestration support to the Global HRBP across Legal, Claims, and Global Operations. Orchestrate HR priorities, initiatives, and dependencies; maintain operating rhythms, governance forums, and milestones. Support coordination of core HR processes, ensuring clear ownership, sequencing, and outcomes. Stakeholder Management Governance Act as an integrator across HRBPs, COEs, enterprise programs, and AI initiatives. Anticipate risks and dependencies; surface them to senior HR leadership and ensure alignment of interconnected initiatives. You will report to the Global Head of HR. What youll bring Were looking for someone who has these abilities and skills: Experience Profile Extensive, progressive experience in HR consulting, transformation, organizational change enablement roles in complex, matrixed environments. Relevant advanced degree or certifications in change management, or AI-enabled transformations preferred. Demonstrated experience structuring and orchestrating cross-functional initiatives (transformation programs, HR operating rhythms, governance, workshops, adoption). Experience translating complex topics into practical frameworks, decision narratives, and executive-ready materials for senior stakeholders. Curiosity and working knowledge of AI capabilities, limitations, and organizational implications. Skills Preferred: AI and process/flow thinking experience, ideally from a consulting or tech-forward background. Ability to design frameworks, drive adoption, measure impact, and upskill HR colleagues. Cross-functional collaboration and facilitation to connect HRBPs, COEs, task forces, and business stakeholders into a coherent approach. Authentic and impactful communication to craft clear workforce narratives, influence alignment, and communicate with credibility. Agility, curiosity, innovation, and growth mindset to operate effectively in evolving AI and transformation contexts. Performance excellence and resilience to deliver against deadlines and maintain quality under pressure. Project Management to structure workplans, dependencies, milestones, and governance. Change Management to support adoption and sustained behavior change across the remit. Data-driven decision making and digital literacy to use insights, tools, and evidence in decisions. Risk management and ethical judgment to navigate people risk, sensitive topics, and governance in a regulated environment. Relationship management to build trusted collaboration and influence without formal authority. Ability to operate autonomously in a highly matrixed environment, navigating complexity and ambiguity.

Be a part of a place where challenges are measured in billions, qubits and nanoseconds. Build your career in an environment where we’re advancing machine learning, leveraging blockchains, and harnessing FinTech. Working in Barclays technology, you’ll reimagine possibilities: learning and innovating to solve the challenges ahead, delivering for millions of customers. We are shaping the future of financial technology. Why not join us and make it happen here? Where will you be located? Explore location Join us as Program Lead - India Strategy Private Bank, where you will lead and govern large-scale, technology-led strategic transformation initiatives across Private Banking platforms and capabilities delivered from India. You will act as a strategic execution partner to the PB India CIO, driving disciplined delivery, robust governance, and measurable outcomes aligned with global strategy while ensuring compliance with India-specific regulatory and resilience requirements.To be successful in this role, you should:Demonstrate deep expertise in executing large-scale technology transformation programs within Private Banking, Wealth Management, or Capital MarketsHave strong program governance, financial management, and multi-stakeholder delivery capabilitiesExhibit exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills at senior leadership (CIO/COO/global heads) levelBe capable of driving execution discipline across complex, matrixed environmentsBring a strong understanding of regulatory, resilience, and control frameworks in financial servicesEssential Skills / Basic Qualifications:Experience in technology transformation, program delivery, or change leadership rolesBachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline (MBA preferred)Significant experience in Private Banking, Wealth Management, or other regulated financial environmentsProven track record of owning and delivering multi-year, multi-platform transformation programsStrong knowledge of program governance, risk management, and enterprise-scale deliveryRelevant certifications such as PMP, PgMP, SAFe, Agile, or ITIL (preferred)Desirable Skills / Preferred Qualifications:Experience working across global and India-based engineering and business teamsStrong understanding of architecture transformation, data modernization, and digital enablementExposure to regulatory remediation, audit programs, and resilience frameworksAbility to drive engineering culture, ownership, and accountability within large teamsYou may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as:Technology transformation strategy executionLarge-scale program delivery and governanceRisk, compliance, and regulatory alignmentStakeholder management and executive communicationFinancial oversight and value realizationEngineering culture and execution excellenceJob location is Mumbai.Purpose of the roleTo manage the efficient delivery of large-scale technical projects and capabilities across the bank and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and expectations throughout the software product lifecycle, adhering to agreed time, budget and quality requirements. AccountabilitiesManagement of the delivery, resource allocation and improvement of complex technical project capabilities across the bank using Agile/Scrum methodologies for planning, stand-ups, demos, retrospectives and the execution of sprints.Collaboration with customers and business teams to manage and implement customer trails to support the proposal of technically feasible solutions, and effort and timeline expectations.Collaboration with software engineers, quality teams, product managers and other engineering teams to deliver high-quality products and features through the software project lifecycle aligned to the banks objectives, regulation and security policies.Identification, assessment, and mitigation of risks associated with technical projects to prepare the bank for potential challenges.Management of change requests and communication with stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.Management of vendor relations involved in technical projects to ensure they deliver according to agreed terms.Stay abreast of the latest industry technology trends and technologies, to evaluate and adopt new approaches to improving deliver outcomes and to foster a culture of continuous learning, technical excellence and growth.Vice President ExpectationsTo contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave. Our purpose We’re a global, vital and highly respected financial organisation with an inspiring Purpose. A career with us can offer incredible variety, depth and breadth of experience, and the chance to learn from some of the best minds in technology and finance. To find out more about Barclays' strategy please click here. Equal opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer and opposed to discrimination on any grounds. It is the policy of Barclays to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, colour, creed, religion, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law. Right to work statement Barclays is required by law to confirm that you have the Legal Right to Work in any role that you apply for. If you currently hold a work visa sponsored by Barclays, or you would require sponsorship from Barclays, you must declare this as part of your application. Sponsored visas are role and entity specific and any changes must be reviewed. It is important that you ensure you are working on the correct visa at all times. Failure to accurately disclose your visa status or Legal Right to Work may result in your application or any employment offer being withdrawn at any time. role: VP - Head of Sales – Global Markets

evidence.quote: Global CEO and will work closely with delivery

normalizedText: Job Summary The VP - Head of Sales – Global Markets, is a strategic and high-impact leadership role responsible for formulating and executing a global sales strategy aimed at delivering aggressive revenue and profitability goals. The ideal candidate will be a proven sales leader with deep experience in cybersecurity (mandatory), a strong experience & knowledge of the enterprise & SME markets, and a passion for building high-performance teams and scalable sales engines. The role will directly report to the Global CEO and will work closely with delivery, marketing, and management teams. This role will craft the Global Sales strategy, cultivate key partnerships, and develop a high-performance team of sales professionals, balancing aggressive growth with disciplined margin management. This role serves as the primary architect of Global Sales expansion and must possess the ability to thrive amidst ambiguity, build structures from the ground up, and integrate with global governance and shared functions. The role will require to work closely with clients, vendors and internal stakeholders and ensure consistent alignment with the overall organizational business objectives. Key Responsibilities, Deliverables / Outcomes 1. Revenue & Business Development Design and execute a go-to-market strategy for UAE, GCC, US, Australia, and Africa, focused on enterprise & SME clients. Own and drive end-to-end sales targets – including revenue, gross profit, and client acquisition metrics. Build and manage a strong sales pipeline aligned with business goals; ensure consistent monthly/quarterly conversion. Leverage existing networks and market intelligence to open doors to large enterprise and SME market accounts. Manage sales cycles; collaborate with pre-sales and delivery teams to close complex deals. Build an alternate and scalable sales pipeline through channel partnerships. Acquire marquee clients. Develop and manage budgets for business development, events and client engagement; ensure ROI through performance tracking and real-time adjustments. Lead proposal development, pricing, and negotiation efforts to reach the revenue target Identify market needs and recommend service offerings to address them. Continually assess revenue performance and refine strategies to exceed targets. Identifying upselling opportunities in existing clients. 2. Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement Build, mentor, and lead a global sales team; set clear KPIs, performance expectations, and accountability mechanisms. Identify Learning Gaps among the team and provide necessary inputs Drive a culture of ownership, agility, and customer-centricity within the sales function. Work closely with the CEO and Executive Leadership Team to align sales with broader business strategy. Provide ongoing coaching, feedback, and development to existing team members to strengthen bench strength. Collaborate with shared corporate teams (HR, Finance, Marketing) for recruitment, performance management, brand building, and operational support. Represent the firm in strategic forums and cultivate relationships with key regulatory and enterprise stakeholders Embed trust and credibility into company identity through high-level client relationship management. Engage in Client Meetings & Interactions to identity new prospects, relationship building, gathering market intelligence and feedback on services provided. Ensure that ValueMentor is suitably present and positioned in Networking Bodies and Public Private Partnership forums 3. Delivery Alignment Collaborate with Delivery Heads to ensure that client expectations are met and that sales commitments align with delivery capacity. Participate in scoping discussions and ensure smooth handoff from sales to delivery. Provide insights to drive continuous service improvement and connect performance to strategic outcomes 4. Operations & Management Review and ensure adherence to sales processes, tools, and reporting systems to track performance, pipeline health, and forecast accuracy. Monitor competitive landscape, pricing trends, and industry developments to adjust strategies accordingly. Drive channel partner engagement strategies where relevant. Performance tracking using Balanced Scorecard that tracks key metrics like new business wins, client satisfaction (e.g., NPS), delivery timelines, and team learning & growth. Timely adherence to PMS initiatives like Timesheet, Bi-Weekly reviews etc. Key Skills Strategic Business Development across multiple geographies and services Key Account Management & Channel Management Cybersecurity Knowledge Pipeline & Forecast Management Team Building, Management & Leadership Key Competencies Strategic Skills /Decision Making Organization/Planning Executive Presence & Communication Motivational Ability Accountability

Your work will safeguard the organization's integrity and compliance. See your commute Explore location Join Barclays as VP Finance Control Assurance, where core responsibility is to execute design assessment and operating effectiveness testing of controls in accordance with testing plans and aligned to relevant policies, procedures and quality standards providing assurance to Management that the processes and controls within the reviewed Business Unit are effectively designed and operating to mitigating the identified risks. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.To be successful in this role, you should have below skills:Experience in risk management or controls assurance or internal audit.Understanding of SOx and Risk Management practices including but not limited to Internal Audit.Ability to communicate internal control concepts clearly, in a business context.Verbal and written communication skills to deal with internal and external stakeholders. Key Responsibilities: - Develop and execute long-term growth and expansion strategies. - Identify, evaluate, and convert new business opportunities and partnerships. - Lead market research, business planning, and investment evaluations. - Drive strategic alliances with corporate, government, and industry stakeholders. - Oversee project execution, ensuring adherence to budgets, timelines, and quality standards. - Collaborate with marketing teams to enhance brand visibility and market penetration. - Manage P&L performance and deliver targeted business growth. - Build and lead high-performing teams across business development and growth functions. Desired Profile: - MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification. - 20+ years of experience in business growth, strategy, business development, or general management. - Proven track record of leading new business ventures, greenfield projects, or market expansions. - Strong P&L management and commercial acumen. - Experience working with government bodies, institutional clients, and strategic partners. - Excellent leadership, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Success Measures: - Revenue growth and profitability. - New business acquisitions and partnerships. - Market expansion and brand visibility. - Successful project delivery. - Team engagement and leadership effectiveness.

The Vice President Director is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing and guiding the strategic direction of a specific department or division within the organization. This role involves setting objectives, managing teams, and ensuring the achievement of key performance indicators to drive the company's success. Key Responsibilities: Develop and execute a strategic plan that aligns with the organization's overall goals and objectives. Monitor industry trends and market conditions to adapt the strategy as needed. Provide strong leadership and direction to departmental teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performance work environment. Hire, train, and mentor staff as necessary. Manage the department's budget, ensuring that resources are allocated effectively and that financial goals are met or exceeded. Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the department's success. Implement improvements and corrective actions when necessary. Collaborate with other department heads and executives to ensure seamless operations and alignment of strategies. Stay up-to-date with industry regulations and ensure the department's activities comply with all relevant laws and regulations. Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to protect the department and the organization from adverse impacts. Drive innovation within the department and identify opportunities for process improvement and efficiency. Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, partners, vendors, and regulatory bodies. Provide regular reports and updates to the executive team or board of directors regarding the department's performance, challenges, and opportunities. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Master's degree preferred). Extensive experience (X+ years) in a leadership role within the industry or a related field. Proven track record of strategic planning and execution. Strong financial acumen and budget management skills. Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Ability to lead and motivate teams to achieve their goals. Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Knowledge of industry-specific regulations and best practices. Demonstrated ability to drive innovation and continuous improvement. Adaptability and willingness to take on new challenges. Job Type: Full-time / Freelance / Part-time / Contract Location: Chandigarh (U.T.) Position Overview:<\\\/p>

As the Head of Strategic Alliances for a Life Insurance company, you will play a pivotal role in driving growth and expanding our distribution network through strategic partnerships with third\-party distributors, including corporate agents, digital platforms, insurance brokers, and other key alliances. Reporting directly to the Chief Distribution Officer, you will lead the development and execution of alliance strategies to maximize sales and distribution reach on a national scale.<\\\/p>

Key Responsibilities:<\\\/b><\\\/p>

  • Develop and implement strategic alliance plans to identify, cultivate, and manage partnerships with third\-party distributors, including corporate agents, digital platforms, insurance brokers, and other relevant channels.<\\\/span><\\\/li>
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including sales, marketing, product development, and underwriting teams, to align alliance strategies with business objectives and market dynamics.<\\\/span><\\\/li>
  • Lead negotiations and contractual discussions with potential alliance partners, ensuring mutually beneficial agreements that drive sales growth and enhance market presence.<\\\/span><\\\/li>
  • Provide leadership and guidance to regional alliance teams to execute alliance initiatives effectively and achieve sales targets.<\\\/span><\\\/li>
  • Analyze market trends, competitor activities, and customer insights to identify opportunities for strategic alliances and differentiate our offerings in the market.<\\\/span><\\\/li>
  • Monitor and evaluate the performance of alliance partnerships, tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) and implementing corrective actions as needed to optimize results.<\\\/span><\\\/li>
  • Foster strong relationships with alliance partners, serving as the primary point of contact and addressing any issues or concerns in a timely and effective manner.<\\\/span><\\\/li>
  • Stay abreast of industry regulations, market developments, and emerging trends in distribution channels to anticipate challenges and capitalize on opportunities.<\\\/span><\\\/li>
  • Prepare and present regular reports and updates on alliance performance, initiatives, and key insights to senior management and other stakeholders.<\\\/span><\\\/li><\\\/ul>

    Requirements<\\\/h3>

    Qualifications:<\\\/b><\\\/p>

    • Bachelor\x27s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.<\\\/span><\\\/li>
    • 15+ years of experience in strategic alliance management, sales, or business development within the insurance or financial services industry.<\\\/span><\\\/li>
    • Proven track record of successfully developing and managing strategic partnerships with third\-party distributors, including corporate agents, digital platforms, insurance brokers, and other relevant channels.<\\\/span><\\\/li>
    • Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and inspire cross\-functional teams to achieve common goals.<\\\/span><\\\/li>
    • Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and influence key stakeholders at all levels.<\\\/span><\\\/li>
    • Strategic thinker with a results\-oriented mindset and a focus on driving business growth and profitability.<\\\/span><\\\/li>
    • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, analyze market trends, and make data\-driven decisions.<\\\/span><\\\/li>
    • Sound understanding of insurance products, distribution channels, and regulatory requirements.<\\\/span><\\\/li>

We're looking for a creative force who leads from the front, shapes culture from the inside out, and knows exactly what it takes to get great work made. As Group Creative Director, you will be the creative conscience of the agency, setting the standard not just by assigning work, but by understanding the work deeply enough to unblock it when it matters most. This is a role for someone who has earned their stripes in agency life, understands the full machinery of creative delivery, and whose hands-on technical knowledge makes them a genuine resource to the people around them, not just a title above them. What You'll Do Be the Practical Problem-Solver the Team Needs When the team hits a wall, you're the one who knows how to climb it. Whether it's a design execution challenge, a production constraint, a motion problem, or an AI workflow that isn't behaving, you can step in with a real, working solution rather than a theoretical one Your value in those moments comes from having actually done the work at some point, knowing the tools, understanding the process, and being able to show rather than just tell Identify creative and technical blockers early, and resolve them before they become delays or compromises in quality Establish ways of working that give the team clarity, reduce friction, and raise the floor on output Lead with Craft and Creative Authority Set the visual and conceptual tone across campaigns, brands, and platforms Maintain a strong, consistent aesthetic point of view that elevates every piece of work that leaves the building Be the person in the room who can tell whether an idea is truly great, and articulate clearly and specifically why Think Strategically, Create Deliberately Partner with strategy and account leadership to develop creative briefs that are sharp, provocative, and genuinely useful Translate brand positioning, audience insight, and business objectives into creative territory that is both distinctive and effective Anticipate client needs before they are articulated. Read between the lines of a brief and pre-empt creative pivots before they become problems Scope, Plan, and Protect the Work Bring a grounded understanding of what it actually takes to execute ideas well, and use that to scope workstreams realistically and responsibly Identify early where a project might hit friction, whether creative, technical, or logistical, and resolve it upstream Build timelines and resource plans that protect quality without sacrificing pace Communicate with Clarity and Conviction A sharp communicator both internally and externally, able to present ideas, navigate feedback, and align stakeholders with equal confidence A natural storyteller who can structure a narrative whether in a credentials deck, a pitch room, or an all-hands. The kind of person whose presentations people actually remember Skilled at reading a room and knowing when to push, when to reframe, and when something simply isn't working yet. Able to have those honest conversations with tact and without ambiguity Rally creative teams around a vision and give them the kind of direction that is specific enough to act on Build and Elevate the Creative Department Mentor creative teams with specificity: not just what is wrong, but how to fix it and why it matters Create an environment where junior talent is challenged, developed, and retained Set the tone for creative culture: rigorous, curious, collaborative, and ambitious Own the AI Creative Frontier Be the agency's lead practitioner and evangelist for AI in creative work. Fluent in generative image, video, copy, and audio tools, and always current with the evolving landscape Go beyond generation: architect AI-assisted workflows and production pipelines that meaningfully improve creative output, speed, and scale Identify where AI creates genuine creative opportunity versus where it compromises craft, and make those calls with authority Educate and upskill the creative department on AI tools, establishing shared standards for their ethical and effective use Collaborate with technology and production partners to design bespoke AI solutions for client challenges What You Bring Experience 15+ years in creative roles, with a significant portion spent in agency environments (integrated, digital, or brand) Proven experience leading creative departments or large multi-disciplinary creative teams A portfolio that demonstrates range across brand, campaign, digital, and experiential, with a clear and ownable aesthetic sensibility Industry award recognition is a strong differentiator and speaks to a consistent standard of creative ambition. Shortlists, wins, and a culture of entering work are all signals we take seriously Hard Skills and Technical Range Genuine proficiency across the tools and disciplines relevant to modern creative production: design, art direction, motion, digital, and AI-assisted workflows Enough technical depth in each area to diagnose problems, propose solutions, and demonstrate them when needed Not expected to execute every deliverable day-to-day, but absolutely expected to know how, and to use that knowledge to make the team sharper Creative and Strategic Capability A thinker and a maker in equal measure, able to move between strategic framework and craft-level execution without losing quality at either end Strong design instincts and visual literacy, equally comfortable directing photography, motion, digital design, and emerging formats The ability to hold a brand truth and a big idea simultaneously, and translate both into work that resonates AI Proficiency Active, working knowledge of leading generative AI tools (image, video, language, audio): not surface-level familiarity, but genuine hands-on expertise Experience designing or implementing AI into creative and production workflows An informed, evolving perspective on where AI is heading and what it means for the creative industry Communication and Storytelling Exceptional presenter and communicator, comfortable in the boardroom, the pitch, and the internal critique with equal conviction A natural instinct for narrative: how to structure a story, build tension, land a point, and leave a room energised Direct, clear, and credible in the way they give feedback and manage expectations The Kind of Person You Are You don't just have taste, you can articulate it. You don't just delegate, you demonstrate. You're not threatened by AI; you're ahead of it. You've sat in enough pitches to know when an idea is campaign-ready and when it's still a sketch, and you're not afraid to say so clearly, even when it's uncomfortable. You know the difference between a production problem and a creative problem. You know when a brief is actually good. You've done the work yourself long enough to know exactly where teams get stuck, and you show up to those moments with practical answers, not just encouragement. You believe that craft and speed are not opposites. That strategy and beauty belong together. And that the best creative leaders are the ones still learning. Why This Role This is a genuine leadership position with real creative authority, not a bureaucratic title. You'll work on brands that matter, alongside people who care deeply about what they make. The agency is at an inflection point, investing seriously in AI capability, new creative formats, and a more integrated way of working. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers). We're not looking for a figurehead. We're looking for a creative force who leads from the front, shapes culture from the inside out, and knows exactly what it takes to get great work made. As Group Creative Director, you will be the creative conscience of the agency, setting the standard not just by assigning work, but by understanding the work deeply enough to unblock it when it matters most. This is a role for someone who has earned their stripes in agency life, understands the full machinery of creative delivery, and whose hands-on technical knowledge makes them a genuine resource to the people around them, not just a title above them. What You'll Do Be the Practical Problem-Solver the Team Needs When the team hits a wall, you're the one who knows how to climb it. Whether it's a design execution challenge, a production constraint, a motion problem, or an AI workflow that isn't behaving, you can step in with a real, working solution rather than a theoretical one Your value in those moments comes from having actually done the work at some point, knowing the tools, understanding the process, and being able to show rather than just tell Identify creative and technical blockers early, and resolve them before they become delays or compromises in quality Establish ways of working that give the team clarity, reduce friction, and raise the floor on output Lead with Craft and Creative Authority Set the visual and conceptual tone across campaigns, brands, and platforms Maintain a strong, consistent aesthetic point of view that elevates every piece of work that leaves the building Be the person in the room who can tell whether an idea is truly great, and articulate clearly and specifically why Think Strategically, Create Deliberately Partner with strategy and account leadership to develop creative briefs that are sharp, provocative, and genuinely useful Translate brand positioning, audience insight, and business objectives into creative territory that is both distinctive and effective Anticipate client needs before they are articulated. Read between the lines of a brief and pre-empt creative pivots before they become problems Scope, Plan, and Protect the Work Bring a grounded understanding of what it actually takes to execute ideas well, and use that to scope workstreams realistically and responsibly Identify early where a project might hit friction, whether creative, technical, or logistical, and resolve it upstream Build timelines and resource plans that protect quality without sacrificing pace Communicate with Clarity and Conviction A sharp communicator both internally and externally, able to present ideas, navigate feedback, and align stakeholders with equal confidence A natural storyteller who can structure a narrative whether in a credentials deck, a pitch room, or an all-hands. The kind of person whose presentations people actually remember Skilled at reading a room and knowing when to push, when to reframe, and when something simply isn't working yet. Able to have those honest conversations with tact and without ambiguity Rally creative teams around a vision and give them the kind of direction that is specific enough to act on Build and Elevate the Creative Department Mentor creative teams with specificity: not just what is wrong, but how to fix it and why it matters Create an environment where junior talent is challenged, developed, and retained Set the tone for creative culture: rigorous, curious, collaborative, and ambitious Own the AI Creative Frontier Be the agency's lead practitioner and evangelist for AI in creative work. Fluent in generative image, video, copy, and audio tools, and always current with the evolving landscape Go beyond generation: architect AI-assisted workflows and production pipelines that meaningfully improve creative output, speed, and scale Identify where AI creates genuine creative opportunity versus where it compromises craft, and make those calls with authority Educate and upskill the creative department on AI tools, establishing shared standards for their ethical and effective use Collaborate with technology and production partners to design bespoke AI solutions for client challenges What You Bring Experience 15+ years in creative roles, with a significant portion spent in agency environments (integrated, digital, or brand) Proven experience leading creative departments or large multi-disciplinary creative teams A portfolio that demonstrates range across brand, campaign, digital, and experiential, with a clear and ownable aesthetic sensibility Industry award recognition is a strong differentiator and speaks to a consistent standard of creative ambition. Shortlists, wins, and a culture of entering work are all signals we take seriously Hard Skills and Technical Range Genuine proficiency across the tools and disciplines relevant to modern creative production: design, art direction, motion, digital, and AI-assisted workflows Enough technical depth in each area to diagnose problems, propose solutions, and demonstrate them when needed Not expected to execute every deliverable day-to-day, but absolutely expected to know how, and to use that knowledge to make the team sharper Creative and Strategic Capability A thinker and a maker in equal measure, able to move between strategic framework and craft-level execution without losing quality at either end Strong design instincts and visual literacy, equally comfortable directing photography, motion, digital design, and emerging formats The ability to hold a brand truth and a big idea simultaneously, and translate both into work that resonates AI Proficiency Active, working knowledge of leading generative AI tools (image, video, language, audio): not surface-level familiarity, but genuine hands-on expertise Experience designing or implementing AI into creative and production workflows An informed, evolving perspective on where AI is heading and what it means for the creative industry Communication and Storytelling Exceptional presenter and communicator, comfortable in the boardroom, the pitch, and the internal critique with equal conviction A natural instinct for narrative: how to structure a story, build tension, land a point, and leave a room energised Direct, clear, and credible in the way they give feedback and manage expectations The Kind of Person You Are You don't just have taste, you can articulate it. You don't just delegate, you demonstrate. You're not threatened by AI; you're ahead of it. You've sat in enough pitches to know when an idea is campaign-ready and when it's still a sketch, and you're not afraid to say so clearly, even when it's uncomfortable. You know the difference between a production problem and a creative problem. You know when a brief is actually good. You've done the work yourself long enough to know exactly where teams get stuck, and you show up to those moments with practical answers, not just encouragement. You believe that craft and speed are not opposites. That strategy and beauty belong together. And that the best creative leaders are the ones still learning. Why This Role This is a genuine leadership position with real creative authority, not a bureaucratic title. You'll work on brands that matter, alongside people who care deeply about what they make. The agency is at an inflection point, investing seriously in AI capability, new creative formats, and a more integrated way of working. We're looking for a creative force who leads from the front, shapes culture from the inside out, and knows exactly what it takes to get great work made. As Group Creative Director, you will be the creative conscience of the agency, setting the standard not just by assigning work, but by understanding the work deeply enough to unblock it when it matters most. This is a role for someone who has earned their stripes in agency life, understands the full machinery of creative delivery, and whose hands-on technical knowledge makes them a genuine resource to the people around them, not just a title above them. What You'll Do Be the Practical Problem-Solver the Team Needs When the team hits a wall, you're the one who knows how to climb it. Whether it's a design execution challenge, a production constraint, a motion problem, or an AI workflow that isn't behaving, you can step in with a real, working solution rather than a theoretical one Your value in those moments comes from having actually done the work at some point, knowing the tools, understanding the process, and being able to show rather than just tell Identify creative and technical blockers early, and resolve them before they become delays or compromises in quality Establish ways of working that give the team clarity, reduce friction, and raise the floor on output Lead with Craft and Creative Authority Set the visual and conceptual tone across campaigns, brands, and platforms Maintain a strong, consistent aesthetic point of view that elevates every piece of work that leaves the building Be the person in the room who can tell whether an idea is truly great, and articulate clearly and specifically why Think Strategically, Create Deliberately Partner with strategy and account leadership to develop creative briefs that are sharp, provocative, and genuinely useful Translate brand positioning, audience insight, and business objectives into creative territory that is both distinctive and effective Anticipate client needs before they are articulated. Read between the lines of a brief and pre-empt creative pivots before they become problems Scope, Plan, and Protect the Work Bring a grounded understanding of what it actually takes to execute ideas well, and use that to scope workstreams realistically and responsibly Identify early where a project might hit friction, whether creative, technical, or logistical, and resolve it upstream Build timelines and resource plans that protect quality without sacrificing pace Communicate with Clarity and Conviction A sharp communicator both internally and externally, able to present ideas, navigate feedback, and align stakeholders with equal confidence A natural storyteller who can structure a narrative whether in a credentials deck, a pitch room, or an all-hands. The kind of person whose presentations people actually remember Skilled at reading a room and knowing when to push, when to reframe, and when something simply isn't working yet. Able to have those honest conversations with tact and without ambiguity Rally creative teams around a vision and give them the kind of direction that is specific enough to act on Build and Elevate the Creative Department Mentor creative teams with specificity: not just what is wrong, but how to fix it and why it matters Create an environment where junior talent is challenged, developed, and retained Set the tone for creative culture: rigorous, curious, collaborative, and ambitious Own the AI Creative Frontier Be the agency's lead practitioner and evangelist for AI in creative work. Fluent in generative image, video, copy, and audio tools, and always current with the evolving landscape Go beyond generation: architect AI-assisted workflows and production pipelines that meaningfully improve creative output, speed, and scale Identify where AI creates genuine creative opportunity versus where it compromises craft, and make those calls with authority Educate and upskill the creative department on AI tools, establishing shared standards for their ethical and effective use Collaborate with technology and production partners to design bespoke AI solutions for client challenges What You Bring Experience 15+ years in creative roles, with a significant portion spent in agency environments (integrated, digital, or brand) Proven experience leading creative departments or large multi-disciplinary creative teams A portfolio that demonstrates range across brand, campaign, digital, and experiential, with a clear and ownable aesthetic sensibility Industry award recognition is a strong differentiator and speaks to a consistent standard of creative ambition. Shortlists, wins, and a culture of entering work are all signals we take seriously Hard Skills and Technical Range Genuine proficiency across the tools and disciplines relevant to modern creative production: design, art direction, motion, digital, and AI-assisted workflows Enough technical depth in each area to diagnose problems, propose solutions, and demonstrate them when needed Not expected to execute every deliverable day-to-day, but absolutely expected to know how, and to use that knowledge to make the team sharper Creative and Strategic Capability A thinker and a maker in equal measure, able to move between strategic framework and craft-level execution without losing quality at either end Strong design instincts and visual literacy, equally comfortable directing photography, motion, digital design, and emerging formats The ability to hold a brand truth and a big idea simultaneously, and translate both into work that resonates AI Proficiency Active, working knowledge of leading generative AI tools (image, video, language, audio): not surface-level familiarity, but genuine hands-on expertise Experience designing or implementing AI into creative and production workflows An informed, evolving perspective on where AI is heading and what it means for the creative industry Communication and Storytelling Exceptional presenter and communicator, comfortable in the boardroom, the pitch, and the internal critique with equal conviction A natural instinct for narrative: how to structure a story, build tension, land a point, and leave a room energised Direct, clear, and credible in the way they give feedback and manage expectations The Kind of Person You Are You don't just have taste, you can articulate it. You don't just delegate, you demonstrate. You're not threatened by AI; you're ahead of it. You've sat in enough pitches to know when an idea is campaign-ready and when it's still a sketch, and you're not afraid to say so clearly, even when it's uncomfortable. You know the difference between a production problem and a creative problem. You know when a brief is actually good. You've done the work yourself long enough to know exactly where teams get stuck, and you show up to those moments with practical answers, not just encouragement. You believe that craft and speed are not opposites. That strategy and beauty belong together. And that the best creative leaders are the ones still learning. Why This Role This is a genuine leadership position with real creative authority, not a bureaucratic title. You'll work on brands that matter, alongside people who care deeply about what they make. You'll help define what that looks like. #LI-PP1#LI-Hybrid About Monks Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4 Capital plc. With a legacy of innovation and specialized expertise, Monks combines an extraordinary range of global Marketing and Technology Services to redefine how brands interact with the world. Through Monks.Flow, its flagship AI ecosystem for marketing orchestration, Monks transforms marketing into a growth engine, collapsing timelines and connecting brands to culture in real time. By deploying bespoke intelligent agents across disciplines and delivering culturally relevant, high-impact creative and digital solutions, Monks solves key critical business challenges across the entire brand enterprise to help brands sustain long-term impact. Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services, ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization, Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2025 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in both the Organizational and AI Product categories. As a trusted partner to cutting-edge innovators in tech, Monks earned titles such as Optimizely Experimentation Partner of the Year (2025), runner-up for the Adobe Firefly Partner Award (2024), and Workato’s AI Visionary Customer Impact Award (2024). Additionally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner. AccountabilitiesLead engineering teams effectively, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture to achieve project goals and meet organizational objectives.Oversee timelines, team allocation, risk management and task prioritization to ensure the successful delivery of solutions within scope, time, and budget.Mentor and support team members' professional growth, conduct performance reviews, provide actionable feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement.Evaluation and enhancement of engineering processes, tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency, streamline workflows, and optimize team productivity.Collaboration with business partners, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions and ensure a cohesive approach to product development.Enforcement of technology standards, facilitate peer reviews, and implement robust testing practices to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions.Vice President ExpectationsTo contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. LogiNext is looking for a dynamic leader to own and scale the entire SaaS marketing team based in Mumbai, India. This Vice President of Marketing will be responsible for the growth of our inbound and outbound lead generation channels and end to end brand building. You will be responsible for developing and analyzing the performance of offline and online campaigns, ensuring that all marketing material is in line with our brand identity, exponentially scale the number of enterprise leads, manage, and scale the team and pretty much everything across the board. You will be responsible to build and maintain a strong and consistent brand through a wide range of online and offline marketing channels. To be successful in this role, you should have hands-on experience with a wide range of marketing automation and analytics tools and be able to turn creative ideas into effective advertising projects. You must possess exposure to large scale SaaS based software companies or should at least be from B2B domain. You should have an ability to perform in agile, multi-tasking and extreme execution focused work environments, which can lead you to exhibit your growth and leadership skills. Here are some of the specific requirements for this opening and a list of responsibilities you will be carrying: Responsibilities: Develop and execute strategies to promote LogiNext platform in transportation, delivery, retail, CPG, food and beverage and other similar industries and generate enterprise leads. Build and follow the content/editorial calendar to stick to industry standard content marketing and amplification process to increase qualified audience properties like blog posts, whitepapers, eBooks, reports, webinars, infographics, videos, emails, and case studies. Scale social media presence across all the platforms, identify trends and insights, and optimize spend and performance based on the insights. Preferable own an active social media profile and build a leadership brand around him/herself. Lead the event planning, including working with vendors, event organizers, and design team for on-site and digital collateral. Connect with influential media outlets and journalists to place stories about company news and other initiatives. Develop an expertise on the product features and lead the product marketing initiatives. Produce valuable and engaging content for LogiNext website and blog that attracts and converts our target groups. Utilize strong analytical ability to evaluate end-to-end customer experience across multiple channels and customer touch points for automated funnel conversion. Build, coach, retain and replace team members as per the stage of the organization. Provide thought leadership and perspective for the team where appropriate. Be the face of the organization for all internal and external stakeholders including investors. Possess superior communication and presentation skills along with a long term outlook on the relationship with LogiNext. Requirements: Master’s degree of higher in business management, marketing, science, statistics, engineering and/or technology Minimum 12 years of global (not only India focused) experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, cloud platforms or technology consulting, especially any experience of scaling revenue across US and Europe Experience of marketing methodologies across channels like SEO, SEM/PPC campaigns, social media, content generation and distribution, analyst relations, public relations, technology product marketing, corporate communications, event management, etc. Direct or indirect experience of tools like CRM (HubSpot), Google Adwords, Google Analytics, PR Newswire, Gartner, SEM Rush, etc. Understanding of marketing automation for B2B including concepts like conversion analytics funnel, account-based marketing campaigns, inside sales, etc. Taste of aesthetics and design, love for polished writing and sense of humor with witty communication style to bring fun to the world of logistics.

Job Summary: Tachyon Technologies is seeking a visionary Head of AI to lead its Artificial Intelligence initiatives. The role is pivotal in establishing and scaling AI capabilities, driving innovation, and integrating AI solutions into Tachyon//'s service offerings. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise with strategic leadership to position Tachyon as a leader in AI-driven solutions globally. Key Responsibilities Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute the AI strategy aligned with Tachyon//'s business goals. Build and lead a high-performing AI team, fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration. Identify opportunities for AI integration across Tachyon//'s SAP, Salesforce, Data Analytics offerings Technical Innovation: Lead the design and implementation of cutting-edge AI and Generative AI solutions for clients and internal projects. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and deliver AI-based offerings. Evaluate emerging AI trends and tools to ensure Tachyon remains at the forefront of AI technology. Capability Building: Establish an AI Center of Excellence in the Hyderabad office. Develop in-house expertise in machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and other AI domains. Create frameworks for AI training and skill development for internal teams. Client Engagement: Partner with the sales and delivery teams to design AI solutions tailored to enterprise client needs. Represent Tachyon in client meetings, industry conferences, and thought leadership events. Build long-term client relationships by demonstrating AI//'s transformative value. Required Qualifications Master//'s or PhD in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or related fields. 10+ years of experience in AI/ML, with at least 5 years in a leadership role. Proven expertise in AI technologies, including machine learning, deep learning, NLP, and Generative AI. Strong experience in enterprise AI applications, particularly in SAP, Salesforce, and data analytics ecosystems. Track record of building and scaling AI teams and driving large-scale AI projects to completion. Excellent leadership, communication, and client-facing skills Preferred Skills Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for AI deployments. Familiarity with AI ethics, data privacy, and compliance considerations.

normalizedText: We are seeking an accomplished and visionary Chief Operating Officer (COO) to provide strategic leadership and oversee the day-to-day operations of our organization. The COO will be responsible for driving operational excellence, optimizing processes, and ensuring the company's efficiency, growth, and profitability. Key Responsibilities: Develop and implement the company's operational strategy, in alignment with the overall business goals and objectives. Lead and manage all operational functions, including production, supply chain, logistics, and quality control. Identify opportunities for process improvement and optimization across all departments. Streamline workflows and systems to enhance productivity and efficiency. Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to track and evaluate operational performance. Monitor and analyze data to make informed decisions and drive improvements. Efficiently allocate and manage resources, including budgets, personnel, and equipment, to support business objectives. Ensure resource availability and utilization meet demand requirements. Collaborate with other executive leaders, including the CEO, CFO, and CMO, to drive the company's overall strategy and growth. Foster a culture of collaboration and accountability across departments. Implement quality control measures and ensure adherence to industry standards and regulatory requirements. Identify and mitigate operational risks. Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing operations team. Provide mentorship and leadership to team members. Identify opportunities for expansion, market penetration, and diversification. Develop and execute growth strategies in alignment with the company's vision. Lead change management initiatives and drive organizational agility. Ensure smooth transitions during periods of change or growth. Provide regular reports to the CEO and executive team on operational performance, achievements, and challenges. Communicate operational strategies and priorities to stakeholders. Qualifications and Skills: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field (Master's degree or MBA is preferred). Proven experience as a COO or in a senior operational leadership role, with a track record of improving operational efficiency and driving growth. Strong understanding of operational processes, supply chain management, and quality control. Exceptional leadership and team-building skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate teams. Analytical and strategic thinking, with a focus on problem-solving and decision-making. Effective communication and interpersonal abilities, with the capacity to engage with stakeholders at all levels. Financial acumen and budget management experience. Change management and project management skills. Knowledge of industry best practices and regulatory requirements. Benefits: Competitive compensation package and executive-level perks. Opportunities for professional development and career advancement. A dynamic and collaborative work environment. The chance to lead operational excellence and drive business success. Job Type: Full-time / Freelance / Part-time / Contract Location: Chandigarh (U.T.) India Chief Operating Officer If this job matches your profile, we encourage you to share your CV and become part of our dynamic team, where innovation and growth are at the core of everything we do. If you think this opportunity could benefit others, feel free to share it on your social media—because sharing is caring!
