normalizedText:
%HEADER_COMPANY_WEBSITE%Associate Vice President, Strategic Initiatives - IndiaMumbai, IN%LABEL_POSITION_TYPE_FULL_TIME%Strategic Initiatives%BREADCRUMB_JOB_OPENINGS%Associate Vice President, Strategic Initiatives - India%BUTTON_APPLY_TO_POSITION%%BUTTON_APPLY_USING_INDEED%%BUTTON_APPLY_USING_LINKED_IN%About Impact Investment Exchange (IIX) IIX (Impact Investment Exchange) is a Singapore-headquartered pioneer in impact investing — building the infrastructure where capital markets meet sustainable development. Over 15+ years, IIX has built the sustainable investing market across four pillars: capital mobilisation, enterprise technical assistance, data and impact measurement, and global advocacy. Our flagship initiatives include the Women’s Livelihood Bond™ Series (7 listed bonds and growing), IIX Values™ (impact verification technology), IIX Intelligence™ (a global data hub benchmarking MSMEs on ESG, gender, and climate performance), and the Orange Movement™ — a new asset class at the intersection of gender equality and climate action. Together, these represent nearly US$1.5 billion in capital mobilised, 185 million+ lives positively impacted, 1.9 million metric tons of carbon avoided, and 116,000+ data points collected on sustainable MSMEs. Recognised by the Oslo Business for Peace Award and the UN Global Climate Action Award, IIX is a lean, mission-obsessed team. Everyone here wears multiple hats, moves fast, and cares deeply about the work. If that energises you, you will thrive at IIX. About the role We are seeking a highly driven and independent professional to join the CEO’s Office, working on Strategic Initiatives that are high-priority, cross-cutting, and central to organizational direction. This role requires a rare combination of strategic thinking, strong execution, and professional maturity. The individual will operate as an extension of leadership: managing new initiatives, engaging external partners, and translating high-level priorities into structured action. The Associate Vice President in the Strategic Initiatives - CEO’s team is a high-impact, high-ownership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of new concept development, organizational strategy, and cross-functional execution. You will serve as an extension of the CEO - driving strategic initiatives, enabling high-quality decision-making, and amplifying IIX's voice in the global impact investing space. This is not a traditional support role. It is designed for an intellectually curious, execution-oriented professional who can navigate ambiguity, operate with minimal hand-holding, and switch hats across projects. Key Responsibilities CEO & CEO’s Office Support Support the Strategic Initiatives team and the CEO’s Office in managing and delivering on high-priority workstreams and organisational commitments.Prepare high-quality written outputs — briefing notes, presentations, reports, and correspondence — for the CEO’s internal and external engagements.Support client and stakeholder engagement: preparing meeting briefs, participating in meetings, and managing follow-ups with rigour.Contribute to IIX’s research outputs, knowledge products, and thought leadership pieces linked to strategic priorities. Organisational Strategy Assist in translating strategic directions into structured workstreams, trackers, and action plans that teams can execute against.Coordinate across internal teams to align inputs, monitor progress, and surface blockers on organisation-wide priorities.Support the preparation of strategy documents, organisational planning materials, and internal reporting.Help the CEO’s Office maintain a clear line of sight across IIX’s evolving portfolio of initiatives and commitments. New Concept & Initiative Development Support the scoping and development of new ideas and initiatives emerging from the CEO’s Office — from first principles to structured proposal.Structure early-stage concepts into proposals, frameworks, or workplans ready for internal review or external pitching.Conduct research and analysis to inform the development of new programmes, products, and strategic directions across sectors.Identify new markets, partnership opportunities, and funding mechanisms that advance IIX’s mission in sustainable and inclusive finance. Business Development & External Partnerships Support the identification and cultivation of new institutional partnerships, donor relationships, and co-investment opportunities.Develop proposals, pitch decks, and programme frameworks for new business opportunities aligned with IIX’s strategy.Help build and maintain IIX’s external profile through targeted engagement with development finance institutions, impact investors, and multilateral organisations.Track IIX’s partnership pipeline and ensure follow-through on key relationships and commitments. What We’re Looking For Required Qualifications & Experience Minimum 7-10years of professional experience in a top-tier consulting firm, financial institution, development finance organisation, or impact-focused environment. Those with more years of experience may be considered for Associate VP position. Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, International Development, Public Policy, or a related discipline.Demonstrated ability to develop high-quality written outputs — proposals, grant applications, research reports, briefing notes, or strategy documents.Strong analytical and structured thinking skills — able to work with both qualitative frameworks and quantitative data.Excellent written and verbal communication; able to distil complex ideas into clear, compelling narratives for senior audiences.Proven ability to operate as a self-starter with minimal supervision, managing multiple workstreams under time pressure.Experience supporting or managing components of projects or initiatives in complex, multi-stakeholder environments. Preferred & Desired Demonstrated knowledge of gender equality, social inclusion, or climate action — particularly with an intersectional lens.Familiarity with inclusive finance, impact investing, blended finance, or ESG frameworks.Cross-sectoral exposure spanning climate, infrastructure, development finance, or impact capital markets.International work experience — IIX’s work spans Asia, Africa, and beyond, and comfort with diverse geographies matters. The Person Intellectually curious — you ask the questions others haven’t thought to ask, and you go deep before you go wide.Execution-oriented — you close the loop, follow through, and take pride in the quality of everything that leaves your hands.Comfortable with ambiguity — you can structure a problem from scratch and move forward without needing every answer upfront.Genuinely mission-driven — you believe finance can be a powerful force for good, and that belief shapes how you work.Mature and professionally grounded — you exercise sound judgment, respect organisational hierarchy, and know when to lead and when to support.A collaborator and a self-starter in equal measure — you work well across teams and take full ownership of what’s yours. The PREM Framework At IIX, we don’t just hire for skills — we hire for values. Our PREM framework defines what it means to be an IIX team member: PPassionateDeep commitment to IIX’s mission; intrinsically motivated; purpose-driven in their work.RResilientAdaptable under pressure; bounces back from setbacks; thrives in ambiguity and fast-changing environments.EEquitableChampions fairness, inclusion, and belonging; walks the talk on equity in every interaction.MMaverickInnovative, bold thinker; challenges the status quo; brings an entrepreneurial spirit to problem-solving. Why IIX Work with the Head of Strategic Initiatives team in CEO on IIX’s most consequential new projects — the exposure and responsibility here are unmatched for someone at your career stage.Be part of a movement, not just a job — IIX’s work on Orange Capital, gender-climate finance, and impact data is reshaping what finance can do for society.High-trust, lean team environment — minimal bureaucracy, maximum ownership. Your ideas will be heard and your contributions will be visible.Access to a global network of development finance institutions, impact investors, and multilateral organisations across Asia, Africa, and beyond.A culture that takes PREM values seriously — you will be seen, heard, and valued for who you are and what you bring. How to Apply To apply, please send your CV and a brief cover letter. In your cover note, tell us about a moment when you turned an ambiguous problem into a clear plan of action — and what happened next. We read every application. IIX is an equal opportunity employer. %BUTTON_APPLY_TO_POSITION%%BUTTON_APPLY_USING_INDEED%%BUTTON_APPLY_USING_LINKED_IN%%FOOTER_POWERED_BY%breezy

Proven experience managing HR compliance (POSH, Maternity Benefit Act and related policies), audits and BGV frameworks. Experience running compensation benchmarking, appraisal cycles and ESOP administration. Exposure to Board/NRC-level reporting and governance processes is a strong plus. Strong stakeholder management, analytical rigour and the ability to operate both strategically and hands-on.

role: Vice President of Global Business Development
normalizedText: About Us Zycus is a global leader in Source-to-Pay (S2P) procurement software, helping large enterprises drive efficiency, compliance, and measurable value across their procurement and finance operations. Trusted by leading Fortune 1000 organizations worldwide, Zycus enables procurement teams to move from cost control to strategic value creation. At the core of Zycus’ platform is Merlin AI, an advanced AI-powered engine that brings intelligence, automation, and predictive insights across the entire procurement lifecycle—from sourcing and contract management to procurement, invoicing, and supplier management. Merlin AI empowers Chief Procurement Officers and finance leaders to make faster, smarter decisions with real-time visibility and actionable insights. Zycus is consistently recognized by top industry analysts such as Gartner, Forrester, and IDC for its innovation, depth of functionality, and strong customer outcomes. Known for its enterprise-grade solutions, global delivery model, and customer-first mindset, Zycus partners closely with organizations to modernize procurement and unlock long-term business value. With a strong global presence across North America, EMEA, and APAC, Zycus continues to invest aggressively in product innovation, AI-led capabilities, and brand leadership—shaping the future of intelligent procurement. We Are An Equal Opportunity Employer: Zycus is committed to providing equal opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. All hiring decisions will be based solely on qualifications, skills, and experience relevant to the job requirements. Job Description The Vice President of Global Business Development will be responsible for shaping and executing Zycus’ global business development strategies. This role demands a forward-thinking leader who can leverage new-age technologies, such as generative AI (GenAI), intelligent agents, and digital tools, to enhance sales, drive strategic partnerships, and ensure sustained revenue growth. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of AI-powered enterprise solutions and bring a tech-savvy approach to business development. This includes recognizing opportunities to integrate AI and digital agents into sales and business growth strategies. They will also leverage emerging technologies to optimize the sales process, boost productivity, and enable more effective customer engagement. Zycus (www.zycus.com) is a global leader in procurement technology, recognized by Gartner and Forrester. Our S2P platform streamlines procurement processes, ensures compliance, and drives substantial savings across every stage of the procurement journey. At the core of our innovation is the Merlin AI Agentic Platform, which uses intelligent AI agents to automate key tasks like contract drafting, spend management, and invoice processing, enabling teams to achieve procurement excellence with greater efficiency and autonomy with minimal manual intervention. Key Responsibilities: Global Strategy Leadership: Develop and implement a comprehensive global business development strategy, incorporating the use of emerging technologies like GenAI, AI agents, and other advanced sales tools. New Business Growth: Identify, pursue, and secure new business opportunities in key markets, including leveraging GenAI-powered solutions to enhance the customer acquisition process. Strategic Partnerships: Cultivate and expand strategic partnerships to drive global market expansion. Team Leadership: Lead and manage a high-performing global business development team, fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration. AI-Driven BD Transformation: Implement cutting-edge inside sales / BD strategies powered by digital tools and GenAI to streamline processes, deliver personalized experiences, and improve conversion rates. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with marketing, product, and technology teams to ensure alignment between business development initiatives and overall company objectives. Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including Sales management, marketing, prospects, partners, and industry influencers. Market & Competitive Analysis: Monitor global market trends, analyze competitive activities, and identify opportunities to stay ahead in the procurement technology landscape. Reporting & Insights: Prepare and present business development reports and forecasts to the executive team, leveraging data analytics and AI insights to inform decisions. Job Requirement Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree preferably in engineering, or a technical field; MBA preferred. Experience: Minimum of 10 years in business development, sales, or a related field, with at least 5 years in a leadership role. Proven experience in AI, digital sales tools, or innovative sales techniques is a strong plus. Managed global regions (US, EMEA, APAC) for an enterprise software offering Leadership: Demonstrated success in leading and scaling business development teams, with a focus on global markets. Technology Proficiency: Understanding of AI-driven solutions (including GenAI and digital agents) and experience integrating them into business development strategies. Track Record: Proven ability to drive revenue growth, develop strategic partnerships, and optimize processes using technology. Industry Knowledge: Experience in procurement technology or enterprise software solutions is highly advantageous. Skills: Strong leadership and team management capabilities. Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Strategic thinker with the ability to execute methodically. Ability to leverage data analytics for decision-making. Why Zycus? Innovative Environment: Be part of a dynamic, tech-enabled, and forward-thinking global leader in procurement technology. Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and leadership in the rapidly evolving field of AI-powered procurement. Competitive Package: Enjoy a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and work-life balance. Global Impact: Drive business growth on a global scale while leveraging cutting-edge AI technology for real-world impact. Join Zycus, where technology meets business excellence, and lead the charge in revolutionizing procurement through the power of AI and digital innovation!

normalizedText:
Back to jobsAssociate Vice President, Marketplace and Partnerships, IndiaGurgaon, IndiaApplyAbout WPP Media WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working. For more information, visit wppmedia.com.About WPP Media WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com. WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values: Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. Key Responsibilities: Lead the growth and development of Addressable TV solutions across the North region, driving adoption and strengthening market presence. Develop and implement regional growth strategies aligned with business objectives and evolving client needs. Partner with clients and internal teams to design data-driven, audience-led advertising solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes. Build and nurture strong relationships with key clients, agencies, broadcasters, and strategic partners to foster long-term collaboration. Identify new business opportunities while expanding existing client engagements through strategic planning and consultative partnerships. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Strategy, Planning, Investment, and Product, to deliver integrated and innovative media solutions. Stay abreast of industry trends, audience insights, and emerging technologies to shape the evolution of Addressable TV offerings. Drive thought leadership by educating clients and stakeholders on the value and capabilities of Addressable TV and advanced advertising solutions. Monitor regional market performance, competitive landscape, and campaign effectiveness to identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Contribute to the overall growth of the Addressable TV business by ensuring high standards of client servicing, solution delivery, and stakeholder engagement What We're Looking For: 7–10 years of experience in advertising, media sales, or digital media. Strong understanding of the media ecosystem with a passion for driving innovation. Proven track record in business development and client relationship management. Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. A self-driven, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment Life at WPP Media & Benefits Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide. About WPP Media 

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com. 

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com 

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values: 

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. 
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. 
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. 

 

Key Responsibilities:

    • Lead the growth and development of Addressable TV solutions across the North region, driving adoption and strengthening market presence.
    • Develop and implement regional growth strategies aligned with business objectives and evolving client needs.
    • Partner with clients and internal teams to design data-driven, audience-led advertising solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.
    • Build and nurture strong relationships with key clients, agencies, broadcasters, and strategic partners to foster long-term collaboration.
    • Identify new business opportunities while expanding existing client engagements through strategic planning and consultative partnerships.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Strategy, Planning, Investment, and Product, to deliver integrated and innovative media solutions.
    • Stay abreast of industry trends, audience insights, and emerging technologies to shape the evolution of Addressable TV offerings.
    • Drive thought leadership by educating clients and stakeholders on the value and capabilities of Addressable TV and advanced advertising solutions.
    • Monitor regional market performance, competitive landscape, and campaign effectiveness to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
    • Contribute to the overall growth of the Addressable TV business by ensuring high standards of client servicing, solution delivery, and stakeholder engagement

What We're Looking For:

  • 7–10 years of experience in advertising, media sales, or digital media.
  • Strong understanding of the media ecosystem with a passion for driving innovation.
  • Proven track record in business development and client relationship management.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • A self-driven, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

 

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Director - Compliance - Banking (18-26 yrs) Black Turtle Gurugram, Noida Experience: 18-26 Yrs Salary: Not disclosed Skills: Compliance, Banking Head, Risk Management, Compliance Head Job Title: Director, Head of Business Unit Compliance (BUK Equivalent) Overall Purpose of Role: The Head of Business Unit Compliance will, along with other Directors and Managing Directors within the Business Unit Compliance function, be a key member of the Business Unit Compliance Leadership Team. The Business Unit Compliance team is structured into Centres of Excellence (CoE) based on specialized expertise. The role holder will lead the India-based Business Unit Compliance colleagues who support the UK-based Compliance teams. Key Accountabilities: - Collaborate with the Business Unit Compliance leadership to identify activities that can be supported from India, and manage the setup and delivery to establish Centres of Excellence. - Provide subject matter expertise on UK retail banking products, the regulatory environment (including Consumer Duty), and the internal Compliance Risk Framework to India-based Business Unit Compliance colleagues. - Deliver education, training, and ongoing support to members of the India-based Business Unit Compliance team. - Manage stakeholder relationships with Business Unit Compliance Managing Directors/Directors to ensure effective matrix management of the India-based Business Unit Compliance team. - On behalf of the Business Unit Compliance Leadership Team, undertake specific business oversight accountabilities and provide effective challenge and constructive scrutiny to the business. - Provide thought leadership and compliance expertise within the wider Compliance function, including supporting the continued embedding of the Business Oversight Compliance Target Operating Model (TOM). - As a member of the Compliance India Leadership Team, support the growth and value proposition of the Compliance India hub. - Stakeholder Management and Leadership Regular interactions of the role holder will include: - India Head of Compliance - Business Unit Chief Compliance Officer - Business Unit Compliance Leadership Team - Decision-making and Problem Solving The role requires extensive judgment and strong analytical skills. Given the complexity and breadth of coverage, extensive cross-functional collaboration within Compliance is essential. The role holder must be able to analyse complex data and management information and exercise sound judgment across a wide range of regulatory requirements. Risk and Control Objective: - Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to all work undertaken. - Ensure all activities and duties are carried out in full compliance with regulatory requirements, the Enterprise-Wide Risk Management Framework, and internal policies and standards. Person Specification: - Builds Self Insight: Creates an open culture where understanding one's own drivers, strengths, and development areas is actively encouraged and valued. Supports a culture where developing people skills is given the same priority as technical skills. - Developing Others: Sets challenging objectives and takes the lead in driving succession planning. - Enabling High Performance: Sets performance standards and assumes accountability for results. Enables leaders to take calculated risks by delegating trust and responsibility to deliver success in their area. - Building Relationships: Creates and maintains a culture where trust and mutual respect are valued; challenges people and systems that do not support this. Able to influence at a senior level to achieve results. - Working Collaboratively: Builds a culture where involvement and information sharing are seen as essential for achieving shared objectives and agendas. - Demonstrating Thought Leadership: Contributes both internally and externally to the role of compliance in operational resilience, digitalisation of financial services, and the use of new technologies in the sector. Essential Skills / Basic Qualifications: - Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills at a senior level. - Ability to provide strong people leadership, performance management, and talent development. - Proven communication and problem-solving skills, creative thinking, and strong judgment and decision-making abilities. - A solid understanding of retail banking. - Strong experience in risk management and compliance at a senior level. - Understanding of new technologies and the use of data within retail banking organisations. - Innovative self-starter with a challenging yet positive and influential style.

role: Chief Marketing Officer/ General Manager -S&M Cement Building Industry
normalizedText: Chief Marketing Officer/ General Manager -S&M Cement Building Industry People Alliance Workforce Guwahati, Kolkata, Jabalpur Experience: 15-24 Yrs Salary: 35-60 Lacs PA Skills: Sales Strategy, Brand Strategy, Marketing Strategy, Promotional Strategies, cement, Sales Operations, Sales Administration, Revenue Generation, Sales Forecasting, Digital Strategy, Ai Solutions, Sales Analytics, Profitability Report, Revenue Analysis, Building Materials Job Title: Chief Marketing Officer and General Manager Sales & Marketing - Cement Building Material Industry Location: North East India (Field travel as required) Seniority Level: Sr. President - Sales & Marketing Job Overview: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) and General Manager to lead our marketing and sales initiatives in the cement/building materials industry. The ideal candidate will have over 15 years of experience in relevant roles, with a strong background in both marketing and sales leadership. This role requires a strategic thinker who can develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies while driving revenue growth through effective sales management. Key Responsibilities: Marketing Responsibilities: Brand Strategy Development: Create and implement a robust brand strategy that enhances our market presence and aligns with business objectives. Market Positioning: Conduct thorough market analysis to identify opportunities for positioning our products effectively against competitors. Customer Insights: Utilize customer insights and data analytics to inform marketing strategies and enhance customer engagement. Digital Marketing & AI Utilization: Leverage digital marketing channels and AI tools to optimize marketing campaigns and improve customer reach and engagement. Execution Roadmap: Develop a comprehensive marketing strategy and execution roadmap that outlines key initiatives, timelines, and performance metrics. Sales Responsibilities: Sales Strategy Development: Formulate and implement effective sales strategies that align with the overall business goals and market trends. Channel Management: Oversee channel management to ensure effective distribution and availability of products in the market. Dealer Network Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers and distributors to drive sales and enhance revenue growth. Sales Growth Roadmap: Create a detailed sales growth and channel expansion roadmap that identifies key markets and strategies for penetration and growth. Qualifications: Experience: Minimum of 15 years in marketing and sales roles, with a preference for candidates who have held positions as CMO, Marketing Head, Sales Head, Business Head, or DGM. Education: A bachelors degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field is required; a master’s degree (MBA) is preferred. Skills: Proven track record of developing and executing successful marketing and sales strategies. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions. Excellent leadership and team management skills. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to travel frequently within North East India as required.
